title: LOTS OF ALLERGIES AND BEST Essential Oils I Ever Bought.
text:
I bought this set last June and just opened it now. The fact that the oils are SO fresh upon opening nine months later says a lot.

A few things you have to understand:

The negative review about allergy upon skin contact is only ONE case. As someone with a ton of skin sensitivities and contact dermatitis, I also got a tiny bit itchy with mixing the orange, lemongrass and rosemary onto my skin but THAT'S BECAUSE YOU'RE NOT SUPPOSED TO DO THAT. These are 100% essential oil, NOT mixed with any kind of carrier. If you go to Whole Foods and buy one of the AuraCacia oils, many are mixed with jojoba oil so that they are easier on skin. Yes, they also have a line of 100% essential oils but these are a much better value. These are FULL POTENCY and VOLATILE which means yes, they *can* burn skin and SHOULD NOT be used on or around pets (do research as I know some oils are poisonous to cats). Any full potency oil can be extremely toxic to children if ingested. If you are making a batch of homemade lotion, DIY sanitizers or whatever else, you add like 4-5 drops for every CUP of product. More than that is going to be way too much. That said, this is actually a REALLY great value for this entire set. And non-GMO, Organic?!!! AMAZING.

text: These are really, really nice eyeglasses. I typically get prescription glasses once every year with my work health benefits. But they are super expensive and I need additional glasses to just keep around the house for when I can't locate (or don't feel like locating the others). These were just perfect for me (I got a 1.50 strength) and actually they look really nice on. I think everyone should have extras (I keep one in my work desk, purse and also one in my suitcase so I can always grab a pair when needed. Highly recommend these to all (these are much nicer than the ones I typically get at my local pharmacy and less expensive, too).

title: Not for me
text: I haven't always had the best of teeth. Avoided the dentist for many years and finally found my way back. I am always looking for a way to brighten my teeth using the strips or just whitening toothpaste. I was excited to try this, but after using it for a little over a week now, I am a little  afraid to use it any longer. This is much stronger than my standard electric toothpaste. I am afraid the enamel might be impacted by the strength and I stopped using it. This might work for others so I am leaving it at 4 stars. But since my teeth are relatively delicate I decided to stop lest I scrape off protective enamel. I might be paranoid, but not for me.

title: This really works!
text: I have suffered from neck, shoulder and upper back pain for years now. I get massages and use massage guns to get relief, but it still exists. When I saw this device I was a little skeptical, but I started using it nightly while watching television. I set it up behind me and let the infrared lights do their work. After using this for about a month now, I can say I feel a difference. The warmth, heat has made the pain minimize and I feel great after using it for about 15-20 minutes. Afterwards, I use it on my face to help activate collagen (my spa uses a similar light on my face as well and my skin looks great). I highly recommend this device for anyone with pain (especially).

title: Good priced, good device
text: This is a really easy to use massage gun. I have been using quite a few of these over the years, particularly for my upper back shoulder area. For the money this is a great device, lots of changeable heads and speeds. Maybe not as much intensity as some of the more expensive models I have tried, but again if you are in the market for a more affordable model, this might be it. I highly recommend this to all looking for a lower end model of massage therapy.

title: Jury is still out
text: I have chronic upper back shoulder pain that I have had for many years now. I have heard wonderful things about red light therapy so I was really anxious to try this. After using it for about a month now every night, I haven't really experienced any major differences. I will say, though, device is super easy to use. I am able to maneuver it myself to most locations (the others I have my husband help out). The warmth does feel good during the treatment. I will update this review in the future if I have any noticeable updates.

title: Such a versatile heating pad!
text: This is one of the best heating pads on the market today. First, it heats totally evenly. Second, it has multiple settings for different heat levels. Third, it has a timer (which I need since sometimes I fall asleep from the comfort).  Last, but not least, it is weighted. There is nothing more comforting than applying this to your back and laying on your stomach and feeling the heat and pressure on all your sore parts. Highly recommend this heating pad to everyone.

title: Love this heating pad!
text: This is a great heating pad. I have suffered from neck and upper back/shoulder pain for years. I love the way I can wrap this around me and get specialized heat to where I need it most (in lieu of a rectangular heating pad). It has adjustable settings and fits me perfect. It even extends heat up the neck which most heating pads don't do. Material is soft and plush and feels great against my body. Highly recommend.

title: So glad I found this!!!
text: I have experienced shoulder and neck pain for over 20 years now. I blame it primarily on a lot of customer service work and years talking with customers on the phone prior to the advent of headsets (and I had to crook the phone between my neck and shoulder). I am always on the look out for a good heating pad and massager. I had been using a standard heating pad (rectangular) but I was super excited to try this. I love that it is custom made for shoulder pain. Once on, it hugs my back neck and shoulders and supplies wonderful heat. The heat is evenly distributed and has multiple settings to give me just what I need. I love that this heating pad covers the whole area that I need help with. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great heating pad for your upper back, neck and shoulders!

title: Keeps my feet nice and toasty!
text: If there's one part of my body that always seems to be cold, it's my feet. I live in northern Florida and, especially this time of year, our mornings and evenings tend to be on the cool side. I keep this plugged in on my family room floor and it's great to put my feet in after a long day of work. Super easy to use with easy to change heat settings. Highly recommend to everyone. This also would make a great gift for someone you love.

text: As an active woman in her 60's, I tend to have a lot of aches and pains. Playing tennis and pickle ball really does an issue on my shoulders especially. This is a great massage gun. Lots of various speeds and intensities, it allows me to customize the treatment the way I need it. It fits well in my hand and is super easy to maneuver. Also super easy to change out the parts to use the appropriate heads. Highly recommend to all users.

On the second try, it did get hot. My question is, why is it inconsistent? Shouldn't each reach the same level of heat every time? My other concern, like I mentioned, was the size. I need it for my back and the size of this pad meant I needed to centralize it to a small portion of my body and I had to keep shifting it to get to other areas. My recommendation is if you are looking only for a small area of concern for an inconsistent level of heat, then I guess this would be made for you.

text: These are really nice face masks with the design of the American flag. I have been wearing them daily, especially during this election period, and I have received a lot of compliments while wearing them. They fit tightly (but not too tight) and cover my nose and mouth easily. I have been wearing them for hours at a time while at work and have not had any discomfort. Great gift for someone as well. Highly recommend!

title: Expensive but nice paper

I typically can go into Walmart or CVS and get the same quality of wrapping paper for half the price. So, although it's nice paper, it's pricey.

title: Better to use on a partner than to use on yourself
text: I have owned several massage guns over the years to assist me with the neck and shoulder pain I have had over the years. I saw this one and wanted to try it. It is super powerful but is not the easiest to maneuver on my own (it was much easier to use on someone else than on myself).  I had a lot of difficulty holding it steady while trying to apply to my shoulder. I did try to use it on my calves and it was much better there. So, bottom line, not good for yourself if you are trying to reach areas that are not convenient (back of the neck, shoulders) but it is great for you to use on others. Just a little difficult to control.

title: Great tool to help work and alleve the pain in your body
text: This RENPHO massage gun was a great find for me. I have recently begun playing pickleball and, in addition to my normal neck and shoulder issues, I now have leg and knee pain. This massage tool is just what I needed. It's super easy to use and I can easily apply to the impacted areas of my body and it helps to relax and alleviate my pain. I love having my husband use it on my back. After having used this now for going on three weeks almost daily, I can highly recommend this tool for anyone looking for pain relief.

title: Great sanitizer with an amazing fragrance!
text: Love this hand sanitizer! First, it's a convenient size that I can easily keep in my purse. Second, it works great and kills all germs (which, during this pandemic, is a great thing). Last, I love the lavender fragrance which is light and smells great. I also find that this sanitizer doesn't make my hands sticky (as other sanitizers do), so I can use it on and off throughout the day and my hands feel, and smell, great. Highly recommend!

title: Great easy to wrap bandage, stays put and is strong
text: My son does jui-jitsu and also is a wrestling coach at a local high school. He wraps his wrists and knees to help gain support and also because he has some psoriasis and he likes to cover it when he is rolling around on dirty mats. These wrap bandages are wonderful. Perfect size at 2 inches and wrapping is a breeze. Material is strong and stays on him even when he is actively moving. This should be a staple in every bathroom whether you need these for something like my son uses or just to help wrap injuries or bruises. Highly recommend.

title: Nothing compares with ZZZQuil!
text: I have been suffering for neck and shoulder pain for years now. Getting and staying asleep has been a struggle until I found ZzzQuil. Might cost a little more than generic brands but in this case you truly get what you pay for.  This sleep aid contains acetaminophen so it allows me to alleviate pain while it coaxes me gently to sleep. I haven't been sleeping this well in years. Highly recommend for anyone who finds their sleep patterns disrupted because of pain.

title: Accurate and easy to use!
text: Really nice blood pressure monitor. Large digital display which makes it super easy to read, it is also relatively compact so I can take it with me even when I travel.This is easy to put on and operate. I compared it to a reading I had just done at a CVS pharmacy and the value came out identical. It also does not pinch or feel to tight (at least on me any way). Highly recommend if you are in the market for a new blood pressure monitor device.

title: Great heat and relief for neck and upper back pain
text: When I first saw this, I was very skeptical. I have suffered upper back/shoulder/neck pain for years. Having gone to physical therapy and massage therapists for many years and spending thousands of dollars, the pain always comes back. I cannot say that this device has 'cured' me, but I will say I feel much, much better after using this nightly for almost three weeks now. I love the heat, I can easily move the device to hit all of my trigger areas and between the heat and the massage, I feel great. I can honestly say that I will be using this from now on between my regular massages and I think I will definitely see an improvement. For less than $40, it's more than half of what I would pay for an hour in a spa. Highly recommend!

title: Wonderful quality ceramic straightening iron!
text: Great hair iron/straightener. 1" model (I usually prefer my irons at 2 inches), it heats up quickly and heat is evenly distributed. Easy to hold in my hand (ergonomic) it only takes a few minutes to reach all my hair. Highly recommend this for anyone in the market for a quality ceramic ionic flat iron.

title: Great massage gun at a reasonable price
text: My husband has had shoulder, back and neck pain for years. He has been going to massage therapists to help alleviate this pain and it seems to last for awhile after the treatment but then it comes back. I have knee and calf pain from years of being on my feet. When I saw this I wanted to try it. There are probably better massage guns on the market today. But, for the price, this is a great unit. I have used it on my husband but, most importantly, I have been able to easily use it on my self (unit is small enough to use and fits well in my hand). My legs feel great after using it.  Highly recommend!

title: Great modern bathroom scale!
text: Sleek, attractive and modern looking, this scale is just what I was looking for. It looks great in my master bath and the blue color perfectly matches the decor. The display is easy to read (large numbers) and only takes a few seconds to calculate a readout. I love the fact that I can send the results to my iphone and be able to track results. Highly recommend if you are in the market for a new bathroom slide.

title: Great vitamin, great dosage!
text: Great source of zinc. I have been taking zinc now since this pandemic was started in February 2020. Never having taken it in the past, I can definitely see the benefits of taking zinc on a daily basis for immune support. 50 mg. is a great size, too, and it's the dose doctor's have been recommending. Pills are easy to swallow and I can take them on an empty stomach without any side effects in the morning. Highly recommend this vitamin for increased immune support.

title: Great way to keep track of medicines and vitamins!
text: I got this pill organizer for my uncle to try. At age 86 he is at a stage where he forgets what he took and I am always afraid he might end up either forgetting to take something or, heaven forbid, take a double dose. I visit him typically once a week, and he has home health aids that come in a few days a week as well. I ended up setting up his weekly medicine, by compartment, by day of the week and by morning/evening and it works perfectly. I also shared it with his home health aid to fill in if I am unable to visit for her to continue. This is a great, easy way, to assure that medicines are taken and at the right time of day. Highly recommend it for organizing for yourself or the one you love.

title: Perfect bathroom scale!
text: I got this scale to replace and old scale I had been using for years. I am super impressed with this scale. Right out of the box, it worked. Large display, easy to read and accurate (when comparing it to the one I threw away, they both had the same reading). It's also slim and fashionable and looks great in my master bath. I highly recommend this scale for anyone who is in the market for a new or updated one.

title: Great way to get your Vitamin D3!
text: I have Vitamin D deficiency so my doctor has me taking D3 daily. This Andrew Lessman variety is great. Easy to swallow, high potency and no side effects if I take it on an empty stomach. I also heard on TV that D3 is also good for building your immune system (in addition to taking Zinc and Vitamin C). Highly recommend!

title: Nice, bright, quality tissue paper for memorable gift giving!

Gold and beautiful designs, relatively strong and quality made,  this is a great way to accent any present. I highly recommend this for anyone looking to jazz up gift giving.

title: Quality made device, easy to operate!
text: Super easy contact lens cleaner. My contacts come out clean within minutes. Unit is easy to clean, cleans powerfully and is small enough that I can pack it easy in my carry on luggage. Highly recommend if you are in the market for a new lens cleaner.

title: Great way to get Vitamin C and zinc!
text: I am writing this during the current covid pandemic. It's funny because I was never one for vitamins in the past, but now I feel so much better I will continue long after this pandemic is over. Highly recommend this economical convenient two pack.

title: Great gummies to help build tiny immune systems!
text: I saw these during the current pandemic and thought they would be great for my two gransons to take to help build up their immune systems. I find it funny that they actually remind me when they need to take them, lol. I think anything that's good for them and also fun for them to take is a win-win. I highly recommend.

title: Really nice chair cushion, supplys great back support

With doing more and more work from home during this pandemic, I could feel my lower back causing me more pain than usual. Since using this cushion for almost 2 weeks now, I can honestly say my back feels great. It gives me the lumbar support I have been craving. Totally adjustable and well made, this should last for years. Highly recommend to anyone who sits in chairs for extended periods of time.

title: Great heavy duty aluminum foil at an economical price!

It is strong and holds its own in wrapping and protecting. I love this huge 500 foot package, it should last me at least 6 months, so it's super economical. Highly recommend!

title: No home, car or tent should be without this emergency kit

Whether you keep one in your house, one in your car or one to take when you are traveling or camping, you will have everything you need for minor injuries and emergencies. title: Great source of vitamin C!
text: These pills are a great way to help build your immune system. I will take one of these in the morning and then typically a lesser quantity in the evening (I have heard recommendations of taking a total of 2000 mg for optimum results). Highly recommend these

title: No way better to build your immune system
text: I have been taking 2000 mg of Vitamin C since the onset of the pandemic to help support my immune system. These vitamins are great. title: Works really well, but is really small

title: Great thermometer for the money!

text: I really love these flossing sticks. Unfortunately, as of this writing, the product does not have an active page so I cannot see what the price is on them (so not sure of the value). This Yogasleep machine is nice, but might not be the best on the market. First, it is super attractive. I love the pink color (matches my colors), the modern appearance this device has and the fact that it looks great in my bedroom. On the down side, I didn't think there was a lot of variety in the sounds and I found the basic sound too high for my liking (I prefer background noises deeper). Anyway, it's purely a preference thing and you shouldn't let my preferences influence yours.

If you are in the market for a new diffuser, this is a definite choice for you. Highly recommend!

title: Perfect size, stays in place when wet

They stay on well (even after showering) and are clear so they blend in pretty well with your skin tones. 16 to the box. Everyone should have a variety of size bandages and this is one we should all have in our house. Highly recommend.

title: Great ingredients meant to boost your immune system
text: Hard to tell what taking this supplement has been doing to my immune system. I am rating it based on claims and ingredients but I honestly haven't noticed anything major as a difference since taking it. I have been taking it for the last month, along with several vitamins, to help keep my immunity high. text: I have been having problems falling and staying asleep for over 5 years now. I have been looking for something all natural and something that would be non-addicting. Next, they let me get a great nights sleep without me waking up a few hours in (like I had been). Last of all, they don't make me feel groggy at all the next day. I really love these and recommend them to anyone looking for a safe sleep aid.

He said the protein levels are good and the ingredients do show vital nutrients that his body needs. He will continue using this until finished, but unsure whether he would buy the same flavor again (will probably move to unflavored variation).

title: Not super sturdy, but good for the environment
text: In my opinion, as far as trash bags go, these aren't the best. They are kind of thin and not as strong as the regular Glad or Hefty bags I use. However, they are better for the environment and they are made with recycled materials. I will be using these for trash that I do no need a lot of strength for (for example, I just shredded a couple of years of tax returns and the paper was voluminous enough that I needed three of these bags. I definitely try to go green whenever possible so I will keep using these when I can.

text: My son has been on a Keto diet for almost a month now. So, when I saw this, I thought he would like to try it. He works out (gym) every morning and also does jui-jitsu every evening. He did like the fact that this is non-GMO and organic. He will definitely be finishing the product, but unsure whether it would be something he would buy in the future.

He is continuing to use it, but I am not sure how much longer he will. Easy to set up, easy to charge, easy to wrap, just not sure if this is worth the $100+ price.

I love the light fresh fragrance of this variety so I have ordered more of this variety. Highly recommend!

title: Great wipes to keep with you at all times!
