text: Nice flossing unit, appears well built, compact. A little tricky to fill up (they could have made the water irrigator tube easier) but once it is, the unit works well with varies interchangeable nozzles. Not as good as Sonicare or other named brands in my opinion (I have a Sonicare unit already), but at less money it's a good entry level unit. If you are on a budget this is a good model and certainly better than not flossing at all.

title: Another great Amazon Solimo product!
text: I love Amazon's own brand Solimo. It's always a great product, comparable to a named brand, but at far less of a price. These maxi pads are soft, super absorbent and you can wear them all day comfortably. I find these comparable to Always brand which I used to buy. If you are looking for a high quality maxi pad at less expense you should be purchasing these.

title: Great generic reasonably priced mouthwash, similar to named brands!
text: I love Amazon brand Solimo products! Always provide a quality 'copy-cat' product of the name brands for far less of a price. This Iceberg Blue is very similar to Listerine and contains the same tartar control. I am deducting a point just because, like Listerine, it's got an antiseptic taste to it. To be honest, I much prefer using Act mouthwash (flavor is not antiseptic). But, if you like and use Listerine then this generic brand is just as good at s substantially less cost.

title: Best protein supplement in the market today!
text: This is one of my son's favorite protein supplements. He loves the chocolate flavor and finds it super easy to mix and dissolve. The 25 grams of whey protein helps him maintain muscle quality and has him obtaining optimal results from all of his workouts. Although this is the xtend variety, meant for intra-workout use, he will use this before as well since he likes it so much. Highly recommended to supplement anyone's workout!

title: Good non-prescription readers for outside use
text: For the money, these are good set of outside readers that you can wear in the sun. I have been using these in the Florida sun when sitting outside on my lanai and they work great to keep the glare out of your eyes when reading. They also are well made and should hold up for years. I highly recommend these for anyone who likes to read outside or at the beach to help keep their eyes safe and aid in reading.

title: Great reading glasses without the expense of an name brand eyeglass store!
text: Perfect 1.25 reading glasses. I love that I can keep a pair in my purse, in my bedroom, in my office, so I am never without glasses. They are well made, fit my face perfectly and are great to read with at a very reasonable price. I like these better, they are more stylish, than the ones I can get at my local CVS. I will definitely be ordering more of these in the future. Highly recommend!

title: Great way to provide temporary energy
text: I used these Good Sense Stay Awake pills during a recent 18 hour drive to the northeast. I found them as a good means to help keep me alert during my drive. I am not a coffee drinker, so this was a great way to temporarily boost my alertness while not having to make rest stops to empty my bladder. If there is a downside, you do crash from these pills so be sure you only take these when you really need them and at the time where coming down from the boost is convenient. Other than that, it's a great way to keep you going without having to get your caffeine in other ways.

title: Great compression wrap provides great support
text: I am a 64 year old woman who recently moved to Florida. In my community, residents love to play pickleball. As I used to play tennis in my youth, I thought I could easily handle the transition into a new sport. To my surprise, my body doesn't seem to want to learn anything new and I found my shoulders, elbows and wrists are having a hard time adapting to my new recreational sport. I use this elbow support strap to help me, particularly during play. I find I am able to maneuver much easier and my after game soreness is practically non-existent any more with this support. This strap is well made, fits my 5'7" 155lb frame well and holds snugly even with my activity. I highly recommend this for anyone who needs additional support.

title: Great little tool for a great, non-disturbed, sleep
text: This is a really nice white noise machine. I live in Florida and I typically can get away with just having a ceiling fan on to provide white noise. However, when there are storms in the area during the evening, I quickly turn this on to block out the thunder noises (which always wake me up). Great variety of sounds to use. The unit is small and compact and really packs a punch when it comes to providing noise. You can also put it on a timer if you don't want the noise to run all night (would be good to help you wake up and set it to shut off around the time you rise every morning. I highly recommend.

title: Another great NuVein sock!
text: My brother (who is about 25 lbs overweight) always uses compression socks to assist him with leg pain. When I received these I had him try them (as I felt he is an expert in what a good compression sock should do). Directly from him, he told me these are some of the best socks he has tried. They hug his calves snuggly (but not to the point of being uncomfortable or cutting off his circulation). They are quality made, having been washed several times they still look like new). He highly recommends these for anyone with leg pain or with a medicinal need (like diabetes) to help with support.

title: Ok, not very strong
text: These are good sleep aids. Notice I didn't say 'great'. Basic melatonin, they are easy to swallow capsules. Taking the standard dose wasn't strong enough for me so I had to take an additional one, so this bottle will not last me for the whole month. I know I can purchase the same amount of melatonin for less money so I probably will not be buying any more of these. If you are not resistant to sleep medicine, you may do fine with the standard dosage. Just not for me.

title: Great long lasting batteries, keep a stock of them around in your home at all times
text: I almost exclusively use Energizer batteries here in South Florida. Long lasting, these Ultimate Lithium batteries are a great staple to keep around your house. A set of these will last in my tv remotes for many months and months. I typically store them in the refrigerator (I was told it helps increase the longevity of batteries by storing them cold) and I know I am prepared for anything which needs batteries. I love this larger size package, too, so I always have a good stash around when the grandchildren visit for toy use. Batteries are packed tight in the box and the overall size fits nicely to store. Highly recommend these higher quality batteries for everyone.

title: Great disinfecting bleach-free wipes!
text: These disinfecting wipes are perfect for many uses. I keep a pack in each of my bathrooms and in the kitchen for daily use. I love that I can wipe down the countertops and be assured that I am keeping all my surfaces clean and bacteria free. I even took a few sheets of these (put them in a freezer type bag) on a recent cruise where I was able to wipe down handles and the bathroom where I was staying. This three pack is handy and will allow you to conveniently place these around your home. Being bleach free is also a big plus for me as I have animals and children around a lot. Highly recommend!

title: Works really well, just not crazy about the flavor
text: This was my first time taking any kind of supplements with beets. I wasn't overly crazy about the flavor of this (why I deducted a star). The wild cherry flavor was overwhelming for me and I needed to water it down more than recommended to make it more palatable (however, in doing so, I am sure to miss out on the benefits). However, Zhou's Beet Complete mixes well with water and it has nitrates and is a great pre workout supplement to take. I will continue using this daily as I can notice the difference in my stamina. I just hope that I can get used to the flavor and be able to try to work my way up again to the recommended mixture.

title: Great individual packets, perfect for many uses.
text: Convenient for traveling, these Tylenol tablet packets are great to take with you on the go. I keep a pack in my handbag at all times and I don't need to worry about them getting dirty or having them loose. I recently went on a cruise and took a few with me in my suitcase and it was perfect. Dual purpose, these are great for minor colds or allergies as well as using as an analgesic. These are a little expensive, but you are paying for the convenience of being able to have them in individual packets. Highly recommend to anyone who wants their pain/congestion pills in convenient packets to take on the go with them.

title: Really nice lavender air freshener for any home
text: I really like this Snuggle air freshener. First, the scent is light and fresh, and I absolutely love lavender as a home fragrance (very peaceful and calming). The Renuzit brand gives me an easy way to keep my home smelling great (I have a dog and a cat) and these are easy to install and remove refills. You can rely on the Renuzit brand for a quality well tested product and this Snuggle air freshener is a great addition to any home (better than lighting candles or using sprays).

title: Great for bug bites
text: We used this on a recent camping trip in the Smokies. I loaded us up with citronella candles and two cans of Off and I thought I would never have to try this. I should honestly have known better. We all left after 2 nights with a load of mosquito bites (despite our best efforts) and they were particularly troublesome to my two grandsons. This treatment really did the trick and help suppress some of the swelling and definitely the itching that the bites gave us. The light orange spice scent was a nice touch and even seemed to help keep even more bugs away when we were wearing it. I can't testify to use with poison ivy or sun burn but when it comes to bug bites this is a nice soothing lotion to use (especially with children) and it's 100% natural.

title: Great water soluble nutrients and tastes great!
text: Amazing way to get your fill of electrolytes, greens and nutrients. First, it comes in a portable tablet which you can take anywhere with you. I break up the tablets to add to my bottled water in the mid-morning work break time to fill my body with the nutrients it needs for the day. I love this watermelon lime flavor as well, it mixes 100% in the water (nothing left at the bottom). This is my new go-to supplement that I love and use daily.

title: Another Solimo home run!
text: My son who lives with me is into Ju Jitsu and as such is always wrapping his wrists and ankles for support. When I saw this brand I snapped it up in a minute. I love Amazon brand products, particularly Solimo, as you get the same quality as a name brand but at a considerably less cost. This tape wraps easily and adheres completely allowing him to wrestle and keep the tape tightly wrapped around himself. This is also a 4 pack which makes it convenient to keep around and lasts a long time for him. Highly recommend this Solimo Athletic Tape as an alternative to more pricey brands.

title: Pepperment oil, great for diffusers, use sparingly
text: Strong scented peppermint oil. With this a little goes a long way. I use this in my diffuser and it adds a minty fresh scent to my guest bathroom. I am not 100% thrilled with the peppermint aroma, a little strong for me (i prefer it a little lighter) so just be sure that, especially when using it in small spaces, to use sparingly. Price is wonderful for this product as well.

title: Economic cost but high quality brushes
text: I love Amazon brand products, particularly the Solimo brand. They always provide a quality product, similar to famous name brands at a lower cost. These brushes are comparable to Colgate brand brushes, but at about half the price. Soft bristles, they clean your teeth thoroughly. I highly recommend them.

title: Great snack bar, satifies all my cravings!
text: I love Clif bars. I always keep one (or two) in my purse for times when I feel I need a snack or a mid-afternoon boost. Great flavors, great ingredients, perfect size. This MOJO variety is one of my favorites. I love the combination of salt and sweet flavors which help to satisfy my cravings. I can spoil myself with a treat while at the same time giving my body protein and energy for the day. Kudos, CLIF Bars for creating another great snack bar!

title: Great bandage/wrap, a necessity for every household
text: First, have to say I love Amazon brand products. They are always quality made, equivalent to named brand items and cost substantially less. This self adhering bandage is no exception. This is a great hand roll to keep in your bathroom medicine chest and use to wrap injuries or simply to hold a gauze pad in place. In any case, it wraps easily, adheres well and protects your injury. Every home needs a few of these around for emergencies.

title: Great laundry detergent, love the Mountain Breeze fragrance
text: I love Purex products. Typically, they are reasonably priced (when compared with other detergents) and are the same quality of others. I love this Mountain Breeze scent, it is light and long lasting and after washing my clothes come out clean. Colors or whites, my clothing is vibrant and soft after washing. I highly recommend Purex for all your laundry needs.

title: A necessity for every home to keep your darker colors vibrant!
text: I love Oxyclean products and this one for dark fabrics is fantastic. I love wearing a lot of black and navy blue colors and this Dark Protect keeps my colors fresh and vibrant and prevents the dark colors from fading. Every home should own this for protecting their dark colored shirts and pants from looking old and dull. One black tunic top I had for several years had begun to look dated, after two washings this shirt now looks almost as good as new. I highly recommend!

title: Solid foot spa device but could be stronger
text: I retired a few months back from my job at the telephone company where I sat for the vast majority of the day. Now, for the past 2 months, I have gone back to substitute teaching and I am finding myself on my feet 90% of the day and after a full day my feet are exhausted. When I saw this I knew I had to have it. I trust the Wahl name for quality and the features appeared to be great. Honestly, it's a solid foot spa. The vibration massage and the fact that the water is warm and covers my ankles is great. Where I am deducting a star is in the power jets for the jacuzzi effect. They are not what or where they should be. Wahl really needs to work on the design and make the jets more powerful for the best impact on tired aching feet. Still, not a bad device for the money (it just could be better) and I may be buying one for my brother during the holidays.

title: Loaded with caffeine
text: Flavor is good, easy to mix and is totally soluble. I am deducting a star because I found my heart racing too strongly and honestly I cut the scoop in half for my next workout and it did seem better (although the benefits were also cut in half). Anyway, if you like working out with energy drinks (like Monster) than this preworkout mix will be for you. I will let me son try it next time he is visiting, but this wasn't really a good workout drink for me.

title: Great protein powder, a little overly sweet for my taste
text: This is a good protein powder. Mixes well, very soluble. I deducted a star just because I felt it was an overly sweet vanilla taste. Please don't just take my word for the taste as I tend to not like the artificially sweet flavors in any of these drinks, so please use your own palate and preferences. High in protein, I feel since using this for the last 21 days my workout and results have greatly improved. I will continue to use these MuscleTech products, but I will be searching for another flavor to help boost my workout.

title: Great dryer sheets works as well as the named brands
text: These are great dryer sheets with a light scent which make my clothes smell and feel soft and clean. Great alternative to more expensive named brand dryer sheets and they come in a box which will basically allow me to have almost a year's worth of sheets in a convenient size box. Cost wise, these can't be beat.

title: Great way to take my daily vitamins!
text: This is a great way to take a supplement. I was diagnosed with starter osteoporosis about 2 years ago when I hit 60 and my doctor recommended I start taking vitamin D3 and calcium as a way to help. I had been taking pills up until I found these gummies. First, they taste great and are a wonderful way to take vitamins. Secondly, they have great texture and form which makes me feel like I am giving myself a treat instead of a vitamin pill. Most importantly, they provide my body with the nutrients I need to maintain and correct my bone density issues. I highly recommend these to all people.

title: Great chewable multivitamin that my grandson loves!
text: My 5 year old grandson loves these. First, they taste great and are easy to chew. Second, I love them since they give him his daily multivitamins and probiotics that his young growing body needs. I honestly have to hide them from him for I am not sure he understands that these are not candy (so be sure not leave them within reach of your little ones). Outside of that, I highly recommend for all children to supplement their daily needs.

title: Easy to take, no side effects and great for you!
text: This product gives me the best of all worlds. I understand the benefits of taking apple cider vinegar and cayenne pepper daily, but I don't like the taste of taking them directly. In comes this new vegan non-GMO product that I can take easily in the morning with relatively no aftertaste and no after effects (reflux) afterwards. I do have a tendency to take these on an empty stomach with no repercussions as well. I highly recommend these to anyone who wants to aid in digestive heath and maintain good weight levels.

title: Great white noise machine!
text: I really like this white noise machine. I typically have trouble falling (and staying) asleep without some kind of noise, particularly here in Florida. With the possibility of thunderstorms quite frequently during the overnight hours (particularly between spring and summer months), this machine really comes in handy. I can set the level high enough to drown out most of the storm noise and I find myself sleeping much better through the night. I like that I can alternate sounds and levels easily as well. I highly recommend this for anyone who needs this sleep aid.

title: Great multivitamin, everything my grandson needs in a terrifc tasting gummy!
text: My 6 year old grandson loves taking his vitamins this way! Not only are they dinosaur designed on the outside, but the gummies are as well. I love that they contain most of the vitamins and supplements that he needs for his growing body in an easy to take gummy. Of course, with any gummies like this you need to keep them out of the little one's reach as I know mine would eat more of them if I didn't control them. Outside of that, it's a great way to keep his health optimal and I don't need to wrestle with him to take it, lol. Great idea, great multivitamin!

title: Fantastic lower cost alternative to Listerine
text: I really do love Amazon brand products and especially this Solimo one. They duplicate ingredient to ingredient when compared with named brands but at a fraction of the cost. This mouthwash is just like Listerine. Although I never was thrilled with this original flavor (just like Listerine), you can't beat the price and quality if this is what you are looking for (I tend to like the minty non-medicinal flavors better).

title: Good toothpaste, cleans and freshens well
text: I have never used any Hello Oral products before. I was surprised as to how well it cleaned my teeth and how clean and fresh my mouth felt afterwards. I can't speak to the whitening aspect of this toothpaste as I didn't notice any difference after using this for 3 weeks. Tastes great and it is vegan.

title: Great multi-vitamin, everything you need for good daily health
text: Great multi-vitamin. I have been taking this daily for a couple of weeks now and I have been very pleased. No after taste or any negative side effects from taking these on an empty stomach. I take them typically in the morning when I also take one of my gummy Vitamin D supplements and I find them easy to take. They contain all the vitamins and nutrients I need and they are far more reasonably priced then the Centrum name (what I had been taking). Highly recommend.

title: Melatonin dosage is good, just don't want to be chewing on these right before sleep
text: FIrst I need to begin by saying I usually really love gummies to take my supplements. I am rating these Revly melatonin gummies as only 4 stars primarily because I don't want to be eating these right before sleep (as I need to brush my teeth again). Seems petty, but taking melatonin in a pill or capsule form seems to be so much easier (and I don't have to brush again). I also didn't really care for the strawberry flavor, but I wouldn't have deducted for that. I will stick with my traditional pills from now on.

title: Great diffuser and I love the vanilla scent
text: This is a great diffuser set. I love the vanilla fragrance. It is not overly strong and does keep my family room smelling fresh and clean. I have stopped using fragrant candles over the years (given the bad press) so diffusers have taken their place. 5th & Company has some great diffusers out there and I highly recommend this to everyone.

title: Really nice energy bars, keep them on hand for an energy burst
text: I let my 28 year old son try these and he really liked them. Great for a mid morning or afternoon snack, they help provide the extra energy he craves before and after his workouts. I love that these are dairy free (considering dairy sometimes works havoc on my systems).  I actually did eat several of these and the banana flavor is spectacular. It's a little high in sugar content (for my needs), but outside of that these are great for a pick me up. I can honestly recommend them for anyone looking for a good snack to keep their day going right.

title: Great paper towels and must have in any household with children!
text: These paper towels are a great alternative to Bounty paper towels. Conveniently perforated to be able to select the size you need when cleaning and they are super absorbent. I recently had my two grandsons over this past weekend and boy did they come in handy. My 5 year old knocked over a glass of grape juice onto my kitchen glass table and it went all over my white tile floor. I quickly grabbed my roll of Viva and was able to clean up the mess fast and thoroughly on the first round of tears. I can noticeably tell the difference between these and Bounty as they definitely feel thicker which is why I assume the clean up was faster. I highly recommend these for every household.

title: Great device to keep in your home to accurately measure your blood pressure!
text: I had been diagnosed with elevated high blood pressure about 4 years ago. At the time, the doctor recommend I either get an at home BP measuring device or go to CVS (or someplace else) to measure it regularly. I opted for the former and had purchased a wrist BP device. The one I had 4 years ago did not work for me, it never seemed to measure my pressure accurately and I found the readings to typically show I was very high followed almost immediately with a low reading. Anyway, I stopped using it and started several times a week getting my BP taken at the stores. When I saw this innoHaus monitor I thought I would try it to see if the technology has improved over the years. To my surprise this wrist device is smaller than the one I had previously and is incredibly accurate. Whether I take it one time, wait 20 seconds and retake it, the results are consistent. I love the way it fits and it is now my staple and I no longer really need to do it outside my home any more. I highly recommend this device to anyone who would like a home BP monitoring system.

title: Great set of oral hygiene products!
text: Convenient pack of both toothbrushes and toothpaste. I really liked this brush, much better than any manual brush I have used in a while (ergonomically fits in my hand and makes getting around the teeth flawless).  I do tend to prefer using my electric toothbrush, but for those who prefer a manual brush this is definitely a step ahead of the standard brushes on the market. Great toothpaste, too, from a quality name you can trust. This would make a great set to give to you kids before they go off to college or for anyone you love in your life who wants better oral hygiene.

title: Great interdental cleaners for every day use
text: I recently had a tooth pulled (November of 2018) and had an implant take it's place (January). In addition, I had some gum work done at around the same time. As a result, I have a small gap of gum around those two teeth that my dentist tells me will (hopefully) fill in as the tooth, bone and gum heal. I can't use traditional flossing techniques and my dentist had recommended my using these between the teeth. They are fantastic. Easy to use and full coverage, my teeth feel super clean and fresh every time I use them. I highly recommend these as they are gentle on your gums but really clean better between the teeth.

title: Good supplement to take daily
text: Well, not sure overall if my teeth are any stronger/better since I have been taking this. However, I have been told by my doctor that I have some Vitamin D deficiency and this combination of vitamins allows me to help the deficiency plus gives my body other critical vitamins for my overall bone and body health. These little capsules are easy on the stomach (I have a tendency to take this on an empty stomach in the morning). If there was any down side it's that the packaging and capsules are so 'pretty' they could be tempting for a child to try to eat. I would just suggest keeping them far from the reach of children.

title: Good daily vitamin supplement for your skin
text: Jury is still out regarding the skin elasticity claims of this product. I have been taking it for almost 3 weeks now and don't see anything noticeable in my skin's appearance. However, it does contain Vitamin A, something I don't normally take on a daily basis, so I feel I am doing good for my body by taking this. Not sure what FloraGLO is and how it works, so can't comment on the effectiveness of that. Overall, if the claims are real, then I will continue to take this on a daily basis. Oh, and these are easy on the stomach (I have a tendency to take pills in the morning sometimes on an empty stomach) and there are no side effects.

title: No difference in my case, but might work for others
text: When I first got these I was totally confused. They capsules have the appearance of something that I was supposed to crack open and apply topically. Took me a few days to finally get around to reading the instructions and realized these were to be taken orally. Really wonder if anyone else was having this same issue. Anyway, not sure of the benefits of this (yet). I have been taking these for 3 weeks (and by the way, they are easy to take with no aftertaste) but I don't see any difference in my complexion or 'glow'. They do contain ceramosides which I have heard are good for your skin, so I am rating this as a four star. Other than that, in my own personal situation, I don't see a difference.

title: Great drink, overly sweet in my opinion
text: Decent post workout drink. High in protein and easy on the digestive system (I have a bad habit of skipping breakfast and then working out, drinking this afterwards has no impact on reflux or cramps). I hate the vanilla ice cream flavor (which is why I deleted a star) as it is overly sweet. I typically prefer an unflavored mix that I can combine with the drink of my choice. Other than that, this is a good protein drink.

title: Why pay more? These are great!
text: These are great fabric softener sheets, work just as good as the more expensive sheets. After popping one in the dryer, my clothes come out static free, great smelling and soft. I highly recommend these as an alternative to Bounce or any other sheets that are (in my opinion) over priced. These are a must in anyone's laundry room!

title: Great supplement for protein and nutrients, so-so flavor
text: Great protein drink, gives you all the vital nutrients you need. I drink this usually in the morning as a substitute for breakfast and before my morning run. I am deducting a star because honestly I am not a fan of the flavor or texture of the drink. I have a tendency to basically drink it without tasting it so it will go down easier for me. I need to check out the strawberry flavor next month, hopefully that will be better for me.

title: Softest skin I have had in years!
text: I have been using Pre de Provence soaps for years now. When I saw this one which includes shea butter, I couldn't wait to try it. After using this exclusively for almost a month, my skin feels, and looks, incredibly soft and smooth. I have terribly dry skin and always use a moisturizer after my shower, but now I have an additional aid to my dry skin in the shower. I love the fragrance, it is light and not overly strong. Pre de Provence makes quality products and I highly recommend them to everyone.

title: Handy assorted antibacterial bandaids!
text: Great assorted sizes of bandaids, handy to keep in your medicine cabinet for any minor injuries. The fact that these contain a medicinal aspect to help in the prevention of infection makes it a necessary staple. Affordable and a mixture of sizes to fit all minor cuts. I have bought several boxes of these to give to my two daughter in laws to keep in their house as well for when scrapes occur with my grandchildren. Great product!

title: Good supplement, sweet vanilla taste
text: Nice protein supplement. A tad on the sweet side flavorwise, but I mix it as a smoothie with blueberries and strawberries and the vanilla does blend well. Not crazy about the fact that his contains sugar, but as a supplement it does the trick as a morning kick start.

title: Great oil, love the lemon scent
text: Viva Naturals has a great line of essential oil products and I purchase them regularly. Typically, I like lavendar in my home to help produce a calming effect, but this lemon really impressed me. I love the light fragrance (I use it in a steam diffuser) and it works well to fill my family room with a delicious clean scent. I now rotate fragrances and use this lemon oil frequently and really love it. A little goes a long way, highly recommend!

title: Works best on fresh stains
text: An OK pet stain remover product. Seems to work well if you catch the stain quickly. My cat who constantly has hairballs left me a 'surprise' on my bedroom rug. Although it did lift most of the stain, I think the fact that the stain had been there at least a day and was dried out made it difficult to remove the entire stain. Keep a small brush handy to help get the deeper set in stains out. It does work but as I said you need to get to the stain while it is still wet for optimum removal purposes.

title: Great flavor and so good for you!
text: I absolutely love these. I keep them on my kitchen counter and take two every morning. II love the fruit flavor and the gummy texture, makes me feel like I am giving myself a treat even though I am helping supplement my calcium intake. I wish all supplements tasted as good as these. Kuds to Nature's Bounty for another great product!

title: I don't know what I did before this Swiffer
text: I never thought I would be this crazy happy about a house cleaning tool. I moved to Florida 4 years ago and my home is loaded with ceiling fans. I am usually able to clean everything but the fans, unless of course I get up on a small step ladder or chair. With this Swiffer, I can easily use the extension and wipe over all te blades simply and easily. I also am able to reach the top of my kitchen cabinets to get dust I had never reached before this easily. Nothing but kudos for creating a product that's easy to use and is now a staple in my house.

title: Great supplement, not crazy about the chalky taste
text: Great mostly natural protein supplement, I take it daily in the morning and it helps boost my workout regimen. Not crazy about the consistency (chalky) flavor of this brand, but I have found a way to add it to a smoothy I make and it becomes palatable. I highly recommend to anyone who is looking for a protein supplement, just check out the flavor and be sure it is something you like (vanilla to me is overly sweet tasting).

title: Great wrapping paper, beautiful colors, professional results!
text: This is a great gift wrap set. The paper is not thin and a great quality and the colors are great. I love having the matching bows and nametags which make packages look like they were professionally wrapped. Only downside is that you are limited to the size of the boxes you can wrap (check dimensions if you have a really large box), but if you have packages which are the right size, this is a great gift wrapping set that includes everything you need.

title: Another great Nature Made product
text: Great alternative to possibly addicting over the counter or doctor prescribed sleep aid. Using melatonin, this Nature Made product helps you to fall and stay asleep without harmful side effects. I usually have problems staying asleep and I will say that since using these over the past few weeks, I have seen a dramatic improvement in the quality of my sleep. I also love the fact that these are in a gummy format, with a delicious strawberry flavor which I really love.  I love Nature Made products and use them often for vitamins and supplements as they make a real quality product!

title: Verdict is still out
text: I work in a high stress environment and when I saw this product I wanted to try it. I have been using it 3 weeks now and haven't noticed a difference in my stress level or being more calm. I am rating it as 3 stars, though, as they do contain probiotics (something I take daily) and are supposed to be good for digestive health. Although I can't exclusively say that this The Garden Of Life Mykind Organics Ashwaganda tablets are the best out there for stress, I would suggest you try them if for nothing else but for digestion.  If they do work for you for stress relief then it's a win-win.

title: Great daily fiber supplement
text: I love these as a good fiber supplement and the fact that they are in a gummy form is just icing on the cake. And they taste great, too (probably would eat more of them if I weren't afraid to exceed some kind of daily maximum, lol). This is a fun easy way to get your daily dose of fiber in a great fruit flavored gummy.

title: Great supplement, not crazy about the flavor
text: Great pre-workout supplement for increased energy. I have been using this now for almost 3 weeks and I have found the combination of B6, along with L-Glutamine and BCAA help to increase my endurance and give me a more solid workout. I am deducting one star because I did not like the fruit punch flavor (to fake sweet tasting) and I am unable to mix with other juices. I would prefer this flavorless so I can mix on my own, but outside of that, this is a great supplement.

title: Great vitamin in a fun, chewable, gummy form!
text: I have been advised by my physician to begin taking B12 vitamin supplements. When I saw these, I was thrilled. I love the fact that these are in a gummy form, makes it almost enjoyable to take vitamins! These have a great flavor and texture and are 'fun' (if a vitamin can say so) to take. I usually take one in morning prior to my workout and typically on an empty stomach. No problem taking this on an empty stomach, no after taste, no stomach upsetting, just a simple way to improve your health regimen in a new chewy form. Highly recommend, especially for people who hate taking pills.

title: Great essential oil, wonderful fragrance to fill my home!
text: I love the smell of lavender and the therapeutic qualities it brings to my life.  I use a lot of Garden of Life products and use the oils in my diffuser, but this lavender is definitely my favorite variety. A little goes a long way and this .5 oz bottle will last me for over a month of daily use.

title: Good sleep aid, works well to assist in sleeping optimally
text: These are a great alternative non-addictive sleep aid. I do have problems staying asleep at night (going to sleep is not the problem, it's staying asleep where I struggle). These do the trick, and are fast reacting, but I am deducting a star because I am able to get the same impact from CVS generic sleep aids at half the price of these. Sorry, Nytol,just not worth the extra.

title: Too firm for my use
text: Good Colgate quality in a newly styled toothbrush. I really think these are way to firm for my mouth so I won't be using it any longer (made my gums bleed excessively). Don't judge my experience, if you need a good, very firm, cleaning toothbrush, this is a solid choice. However, keep in mind that these are manufactured and are designed for use in India.

title: Good quality supplement to take daily
text: Label indicates it is full of proteins and amino acids, so for that reason alone I am rating this as a 4 star. I go to the gym at least 5 days a week and I do like taking a supplement to assist my muscle toning and this one does fit the bill (and it's Vegan). However, I think it is a super expensive product and I don't like the size of the capsules (makes it difficult to swallow).

title: High in protein, a great supplement for anyone who works out!
text: This is one of the best protein supplement powders on the market today. High in protein and no added sugar, it mixes easily with my foods (whether I do it in juice or even sometimes I add it to yogurt). It gives me the nutrition I need for my sustained workouts. I have tried others on the market, but I can honestly say that Boost seems to have the best impact on my health, stamina and overall well being. Great product!

title: A perfect furniture polish
text: I love Pledge and have been using their furniture polishes for 30+ years now. Easy to use, furniture looks great after using, wood is protected and I love the lemon fragrance! An old reliable product that has survived over the years because they make a quality product that actually has survived competition (for a reason). Great product, nothing but fantastic things to say.

title: Great tasting protein bar!
text: I tend to steer away from vanilla flavored snacks as they usually taste terrible to me (too sweet/too fake). When I first saw these PowerBars I honestly was not expecting much. I thought they would taste terrible and would be way to sweet to me. I was pleasantly surprised. I really enjoyed this variety. I feel they actually satisfied my mid-afternoon cravings and I love that they are gluten free and made with no artificial flavors or colors. They are chock full of protein and not only do they satisfy the cravings but also give me a great pick me up for the afternoon doldrums. Highly recommend these!

title: Made my heart race, had to stop using it
text: Only tried this once. My heart was beating and racing like crazy, I was honestly afraid I was going to have to go to the hospital. And, as an fyi, caffeine is not normally an issue for me. Anyway, first and last time I tired it. I gave the benefit of two stars for those other glowing reviews out here. Maybe it was just my metabolism and body chemistry, but I will never try this again. Too scary.

title: Great high quality product, not crazy about the vanilla flavor
text: I buy a lot of Flextarian products, mainly for my two sons (in their 20's). They love a protein supplement in their diet. The feedback in this review mainly comes from them (although I did taste this product). First, the good points: Flextarian makes great, high quality products which will help you add to your workout regimen. On the down side, with this particular Vanilla flavor, one of my sons said he couldn't drink it easily, said it was way too sweet for his liking. My other son was fine with the taste. Like I said, I also tried it and did not like it either. Both sons told me they prefer the chocolate flavor. So, I am deducting one star for the taste factor, but keeping the rating high due to the benefits you will receive by using it.

title: In my taste overly sweet, but it is a great mid afternoon snack
text: I had to deduct a star from theses Power Bars because I honestly didn't care for the flavor of them. Found them too sweet (yes, I know they are reduced sugar) for my taste and the vanilla was just overwhelming. On the other hand, my 22 year old son loved them. So, I guess if you are younger, these may fill the bill. They are rich in protein and are great for a mid afternoon pick me up. I have had PowerBars before and I usually love them, so I am rating them as 4 stars. They do make a quality product and my son loved them so I do recommend them if you like a sweeter tasting protein bar.

title: Great, attractive humidifier, with an added color show!
text: This is a great humidifier. I love the fact that I can add some essential oils in it (I particularly love lavender) and use it to help me de-stress as well as improve my health through lightly increasing the humidity in my normally dry home. My absolutely favorite part about this Crane product is the color changing capability. I have received a lot of compliments using it in my living room where it has the optimum effect for my home. Be aware that this is far from a 'mini' unless they are comparing it to a standard floor humidifier. I love it and hope to use this for many years to come.

title: Great sleep aid, powerful help for getting a good nights sleep
text: I occasionally use sleep aids when I’m unable To fall asleep at night (usually when I’ve had a really long day (either from work, family, just life in general).  The sleep aids are usually use are over the counter generic brands.  I was really excited when I saw this NyQuil product I’ve never used one that also contains pain relievers (although we do have psoriatic arthritis).  I didn’t know what to expect when I tried this, but I can testify that this is probably the best sleep aid/pain reliever on the market today. I not only fell asleep relatively quickly (less than 15 to 20 minutes) but I also woke up refreshed and pain-free from the overnight dose. I highly recommend this for anyone who suffers from debilitating pain conditions and may have trouble falling asleep at night. Keep in mind they say you can be habit-forming, so I would only use it when I really was having issues.

title: Good healthy snack for kids
text: So-so snack for an adult. Small bar, taste is ok but not something I would find myself craving (kind of dry). What I do like about them is they are all natural and are loaded with protein. So, I would probably love giving them to my grandchildren. Just for my mid-day cravings, these really don't fit the bill. I prefer my other protein bars better. Probably will not be purchasing any more of these in the future.

title: Ok flosser, good for a family, takes up too much counter space
text: Not my favorite way to floss, I prefer the newer hand held all in one types (i.e. Sonicare). These big clunky flossers take up too much bathroom countertop space. I guess it is ok for family use as it comes with multiple heads. I read the other reviews here with people saying this has broken. I have not experienced this yet and I have been using this daily for almost a month now (so no problem). I just don't like having this thing on my countertop and will more than likely stop using it soon. Just reminds me of the original waterpiks they came out with, they should find n easier way to make flossing not such a chore (way too big).

title: Great new toothpaste that does it all!
text: I love Colgate products and use them almost exclusively. This new Max Fresh variety is one of my all time favorites. Not only do my teeth and gums feel and look great after brushing (with my Sonicare brush), but my breath is fresh for hours. It allows me to skip the mouthwash as this variety does it all. I have nothing but good things to say about this variety, so I am rating it as 5 stars. Kudos to Colgate for giving me another great addition to my mouth health regime.

title: Absolutely the best electric toothbrush on the market and worth every penny!
text: I have had gum problems for several years now. Started when I 'skipped' going to the dentist for over 5 years. Now, I am conscientious about my oral health and religiously brush and floss. I love this Diamond Clean model. Having used Sonicare products for years now, this model exceeded all of my expectations. I will say, it is costly, but you can't put a price on your smile and well being. I love Sonicare, it's so easy to use and this new Smart model allows me info I never had access to before. Although this model may be out of your price range, I urge you to at least get a basic Sonicare brush to begin to keep your teeth, and gums, in optimal condition.

title: Pleasant tasting, great ingredients, rich in antioxidants
text: The jury is still out on the effects of taking this black seed oil for me personally as I have only been taking it for a month and I honestly don't see any difference. I will say it is pleasant tasting and goes down smoothly (no negative side effects if I take it on an empty stomach). The ingredients state that is chock full of anti-oxidants, so that is a great thing. I also have tried using this topically on some excema on my arms and I do see a moisture difference in my skin. I will continue to finish the bottle and may reorder to give it a little longer to see the results. I have heard great things on tv (Dr. Oz in particular) about black seed oil, so I want to give it a chance.

title: Great large sized detergent and phosphate free
text: Great laundry detergent, convenient large size. Pleasant fragrance, phosphate free and good for the environment, my clothes and bedding look and smell clean and fresh. If I had any complaints at all it would be the way the bottles were shipped and the box had a dent (happened during shipping). Luckily the product was unharmed, but I guess it could have been an issue if it had been a stronger dent.

title: Great tasting, easy to take, does the job!
text: At my annual physical last year, my GP decided to do some additional blood work now that I am in my 60's. I came back showing a vitamin D deficiency. Despite the fact that I live in Florida, I try to avoid the sun as much as possible and I guess it shows now in my bones. I had been taking Vitamin D3 supplements for the last 9 months but when I saw this along with the reviews the product has received, I decided to try it. I am so glad I did. This is super pleasant tasting and I actually look forward to taking it every day. This to me is the easiest way to take this supplement and it absorbs into the blood stream faster than taking a gel or a pill. I will be taking Tropical Oasis from now on and have already ordered my next bottle. This is a great way to increase your bone health!

title: Love, love, love this self adhering bandage!
text: I love this self adhering bandage. I used it most recently when I injured my arm/elbow when packing here. I had a gash about 2 inches long and it was bleeding pretty heavy to start. Using a sterile gauze as a cover, I then used this WellWear to hold the gauze tightly in place. It worked like a charm and held the gauze steady without the need for tape of any kind on my skin. This definitely helps with bandages, especially with kids who don't like the 'pull' associated with standard injury bandage treatments. I always keep a roll of this stuff in my medicine cabinet.for my use.

title: Great, practical and absorbant select a size variety !
text: I absolutely love Bounty products. This is my favorite variety. I am a single female and I love the fact that I can use the select a size feature to only use as much as I need. With other varieties I will use a full sheet every time (unless I attempt to tear a unique size for a smaller need). Usually, this will mean I am wasting paper towels. With this select a size, I can choose what I need when I need it. And Bounty has the best absorption in the paper towel market so a little goes a long way. I wouldn't use another brand. Love Bounty!

title: Great probiotic in a tasty gummy form!
text: I love Align products and I really liked this gummy version. First, it's a strong probiotic, assists with my digestive system and really helps me on a daily basis. The best part about this is the new gummy variety. I love the flavors and the texture and I swear it makes taking a probiotic a joy. I rarely brag about this kind of stuff, but I really love these. If I had any complaints at all, it would be nice if these were less than $20 a bottle.

title: Good, albeit a somewhat expensive daily probiotic
text: I have been using these now for about 3 weeks, so my opinions expressed here must relay that. The jury is still out when it comes to the benefits of this specific product. I will say that I have used Align products for years now and this daily immune support pill is filled with probiotics and healthful bacteria. I typically take one of these in the morning, on an empty stomach, with no negative side effects. I have deducted one star simply because of the price, I think my Dr. Tobias daily pills at a much less cost works just about the same.

title: Best dishwashing pods on the market today. Score another home run for Cascade!!!
text: I have used Cascade primarily in my kitchen for at least 20+ years. They always make a quality product and this new Platinum Plus totally exceeded my expectations! My dishes have never looked cleaner and my glasses were spotless (and I didn't need to use a rinse agent). I cook Italian a lot in my kitchen with heavy emphasis on olive oil. My dishes have a tendency to have a greasy sheen on them when they go into the dishwasher, but now they come out the best they ever had. I am totally sold on this new Cascade variety and will be using it exclusively from now on (ok, well, at least until Cascade brings out another new type, lol).

title: Disappointed, thought it would be better
text: Best thing about this wrap is the heating element. I have to admit that the I have used it a lot since I received this, but I never could get a handle on the massaging mechanism. The worst part of my pain is on the right side of my back up near the shoulder blade area. I was really hoping I could use this shiatsu massage to help the knots I have in that area.But, no matter how I tried to angle it, I couldn't get the rollers to get right into the exact spot I needed. And, even when I got close, it wasn't a strong or deep enough massager to make a difference. So, the heating is all I could really get use out of this device. Disappointed.

title: Great aid for a healthy mouth!
text: I have a real trouble with dry mouth, particularly when I sleep at night. I know how bad it is for your mouth to not keep it moist. I also have gum issues and I normally use ACT restoring mouthwash as an aid to my gums and teeth. Problem is, I can't use ACT at night before I go to bed due to the alcohol content. So, here comes Colgate Hydris. I love how it makes my mouth feel, clean and refreshed and with no alcohol content. This works great for my pre-bedtime mouth rinse. I highly recommend this mouthwash to anyone who needs a mouthwash but can't use alcohol based mouthwashes.

title: Great bandaids, great fast healing of wounds!
text: As luck would have it, the Sunday after I had received these I was cooking dinner and slashed my index finger pretty badly while chopping vegetables. After an initial wound cleaning, I ran for this package and applied my first bandaid from the pack. I was truly afraid, as the wound appeared deep, that the bleeding would continue and soak through the bandage. To my surprise, this bandaid really held up. The blood flow did not continue and the wound was quickly abated. Within a day I noticed the little white bubble showing me the healing has begun. I was amazed that this same bandaid held up while I washed dishes and did household chores as well. I removed the bandaid after a few days and I saw how perfectly the wound had healed. Every medicine cabinet should have a package (or two) of these around, particularly if you have a chef in your family who may not be that skilled when it comes to the careful use of a knife, lol! I was very impressed by this variety of Band-Aid hydriseal bandages.

title: Great tasting tea with healthy skin benefits promised
text: This is an interesting product. Honestly can't testify to the collagen benefits. Have been taking it daily now for a little over two weeks and haven't seen a noticeable difference. I do like the flavor of the tea, though and will continue to drink a cup a day (it may take time to work from the inside out). I do agree with one of the other reviewers, I would probably prefer to use only one tea bag (seems overly strong with two). However, I want to see the full benefit of the collagen, so I will continue to use two until I run out of it. If I do decide to purchase more, I will probably change my regimen to two cups with one bag each (just my preference).

title: It didn't really work for me, but the ingredients show it might work for others
text: Rating as 3 stars because  after taking this for several weeks now, I am not  seeing the results I was expecting. My nails especially send to be brittle and weak (probably because of years of wearing acrylic nails). I was really hoping that taking this would eliminate the need for me to use special nail polish for nail hardening. It didn't. I still see my nails in the same condition. This may work for others, but it didn't for me. Maybe I need to take it for several months, unsure, but I didn't want to buy another bottle if I didn't see it at least starting to work. I also don't care for the drops with this and having to drink it. Would have preferred a pill format.

title: Great energy builder, easy on the digestie tract
text: I have been using this for almost a month now. I do feel slightly more energetic. I walk/run every morning and I do feel less tired at the end of the hour than I did previously and I have extended my workout by about 15 minutes as a result of this. I am not sure if this has caffeine in it which is giving me the energy (I see green tea, but label doesn't show caffeine as an ingredient), which is why I am deleting a star. As an fyi, this is easy to take on an empty stomach, no residual taste or stomach upset.

title: Works great, I was exposed to germs over the holiday and remained healthy!
text: My son was visiting me here over Christmas. When he woke up Christmas morning he was sneezing and began to blow his nose. Turned out that he must have caught something when flying on the way down here. I am 63 years old and did not want to get sick, so I brought out the hand sanitizers and pulled out this bottle of Jarrow Immune.I immediately took one and followed the instructions and took them for the entire time he was here. He left this morning, still with the remnants of a cold and, in spite of it all, I am (knock wood) in perfect health. So, can I claim that Jarrow Immune is what kept me cold-free? Not sure, but I didn't catch anything from him despite his touching the refrigerator and door knobs and coughing and sneezing the whole time he was here. I am sold on this and will now be keeping a bottle in my house all the time now and will also bring one with me when I go to Europe in April (I always seem to get sick every time I am on a plane).

title: Great supplement for my older body and mind
text: I am a 60 something year old woman who still is working full time. I love to take supplements that not only help me keep my body at its peak but I also look for something which will help me keep my mind performing at optimal levels. I typically use Jarrow Formulas products for a lot of my supplements and so I did gravitate to this when I saw it. The omerga-3 fatty acids that are in this product help me do that. I have been taking these for almost two months now and I am very satisfied. I have a bad habit of not eating breakfast in the morning, so taking these in the morning on an empty stomach is a true testament to how good they are. No impact on my stomach and no lingering after taste.arrow makes great products that are reasonably priced . Highly recommend!

title: Great supplement, assists me with my arthritis.
text: This is a great supplement. I am 62 years old and have psoriatic arthritis in my hands and knees. I have been using Tropical Oasis for almost a year now. I love that I don't have to take pills. In the morning, before I go for my morning walk, I mix this with my cranberry juice and drink it as my morning go-to boost. Tropical Oasis contains Glucosamine, Chondroitin, MSM, and Vitamin C and really helps me. Since using this, I have seen noticeable improvement in my joints and my fingers are no longer swollen and as painful as they had been. I love that taking this daily is a great supplement for my health as well as assists me with my arthritis. I will continue taking Tropical Oasis daily and recommend it for you or for those you love who need to supplement and assist their bone and muscle health!

title: Great ear protection for the musician in your life!
text: My son is in a band and I worry so much about his hearing (as I had been in a band when I was younger and I know first hand the damage that can be done to your hearing being subjected to high decibels like that). First, he loves the way these fit. They are comfortable and hug his ears with them hardly being noticeable (not heavy or pinching on his ears). He moves a lot on stage while playing bass and says that these move with him and he has no fear of them coming out. Of course, what they are meant for is helping protect his ears and this is what these do best. He has tried others in the past, but he says in the industry Decibullz are known to be the best. Highly recommend!

title: Toilet paper is good quality, however you can do better elsewhere
text: Ok, toilet paper. Not quite the 'mega' size they state (when compared with my usual Scott tissue). However, it is soft and absorbent with a light fresh fragrance. I am deducting a star simply because I prefer my Scott better. I believe, for the money (about 90 cents a roll), you can do much better with Charmin or Scott.

title: Wonderful great tasting fun vitamins for children!
text: These are great multivitamins for kids. First, they are chock full of nutrients and vitamins that children need. Second, they are a vitamin that it is easy to get your children to take. My 4 year old grandson loves taking these. They are great tasting and with the Marvel Avenger theme it becomes a daily 'treat' to get him to take what's good for him. I no longer worry about him missing out on eating everything right each day with him taking this multivitamin as I know he will supplement his diet with 100% of his daily requirements. These are reasonably priced as well and should be a staple in every parent's (and grandparent's) household!

title: Great paper towels, better than the other brands and a tremenous value!
text: These are my new favorite paper towels. First, they are in a roll larger than most of the ones I typically purchase (Bounty), second they are super absorbent and allow me to select a size most convenient for my needs. Last, and most importantly, I find buying these on Amazon cheaper than what I normally pay for a similar size package of Bounty in the stores and Amazon delivers them (Prime) in two days direct to my door. I am thrilled with Presto! paper towels and they are now a staple in my closet.

title: Great tasting, super quick acting relief!
text: I love Soundhealth products and these antacid chews are some of the best. First, forgetting the fact that they are a great antacid product, quickly relieving heartburn, they are also great tasting with no chalky aftertaste (like Tums). Then, to make it even sweeter, they are even less expensive then my regular antacid I get at CVS. I am sold on these chews and will never go back to other products again!

title: These are a great sleep aid with minimal side effects and additional health benefits
text: These are easy to take (easy to swallow, no side effects when taken on an empty stomach).I love the fact that these are all natural and help me not only get to sleep at night but also have additional benefits (i.e. memory). I am 62 years old and occasionally have trouble falling and staying asleep through the night. These pills have now replaced my CVS brand sleep aids and I feel good about taking these (non-addictive, minimal side effects). I am now a regular user of Jarrow supplements.

title: Great tasting chewable antacid tablet. Works super fast!
text: These are my new favorite antacid tablets. Previously using tums (not just for antacid but for calcium), I really prefer this SoundHealth brand. First, it is definitely not chalky like tums and it actually is a fun chewable pill to eat (almost feel like I am treating myself). As far as curing my heartburn, this was amazing. After eating Italian dinner the other night (where sauces do have a tendency to add acidity to my stomach) I felt the heartburn starting. Within 20 minutes of chewing these, the heartburn was gone. I really like the fruit flavors, too. Definitely hits a home run in my book for a medication and calcium supplement I actually enjoy taking.

title: Love, love, love what it has done for my smile!!!
text: I haven't used Rembrandt in years and now that I have been using it for over 3 weeks I can't understand why I ever switched. I love this Intense Stain Whitening formula, really helps me keep my teeth looking optimal (considering the years of my drinking red wine and tea). I can tell they have lightened several shades since using it and I didn't need to use whitening strips to do it. On top of it, this has a great tartar control formula which helps me with my gums and tooth health. I will never go back to Crest now that I have rediscovered the great benefits and ultimate impact of using Rembrandt.

title: Fantastic multi-vitamin, it truly is Complete!
text: Great daily multivitamin for my 60 something body I love getting the magnesium and calcium that I need along with a variety of other vitamins and minerals to assure that I do get my daily requirements met. My favorite part of these are two fold: first, I tend to skip breakfast several days a week and taking these on an empty stomach have no adverse side effects to me (no aftertaste). Secondly, and probably most important is the price. I had been taking Centrum for years now, but for $5 to have an over 4 month supply is just too good a deal for me to pass up. I am sold on this Nature's Wonder product and have switched to them exclusively now!

title: Great everyday cough drop / throat lozenge
text: The are great very light mentholated cough drops. I keep a few in my purse at all times and a bunch in a dish at my desk (to share) at work. Refreshing, great lemony flavor, a small size, they are perfect for getting rid of that throat tickle I get from time to time. I wouldn't leave home without them!

title: Good cough drop, pleasantly flavored light menthol
text: These are good cough drops. Not quite as 'mentholated' as other cough drops that I am used to (very slight menthol). Also, the size is slightly smaller than your typically Halls brand. Not bad, they are good to resolve the occasional throat tickle. Not sure I would use them if I had a real hacking cough/cold.

title: Chock full of vitamins and minerals as a daily supplement to your health!
text: This is a great supplement to add to your daily regimen. To be honest, I am not much of an athlete. But I am a 60 something female who does try to power walk between 3-5 miles a day. I use this for helping supplement me in much needed vitamins (for example B1, 12 and 6 along with vitamin C and E) and minerals. Easy to take (no pills) I use it in the morning with no side effects (especially as I often go without breakfast in the morning). I am deducting one star from this review for two reasons. First, $51 for 14 count is crazy expensive. Second, the taste definitely needs to be improved, I typically have to 'down' it and follow it up with a toothbrushing to get the flavor out of my mouth. I would really think that Alp should work on the flavor and the price and they will have a market winner for sure on their hands.

title: These are by far my favorite paper towels Use them exclusively!
text: These are great paper towels. Not only are they the most absorbent paper towels on the market, but they come in the adjustable size tears so I can only take what I need to use and not find myself throwing out unnecessary overages. I can't think of another papertowel, including Bounty or Sparkle, that performs as well as Brawny. No household should be without these tear-a-square towels. Made for small or large cleanup needs and absorbs like no other paper towel!

title: Guilt-free pleasure in satisfying your body's needs!
text: These are my favorite protein bars to date. Great tasting, I love how every bite seems to bring me a different texture and taste. I love the macadamia chocolate flavor, too. All natural ingredients, I have no guilt in spoiling myself mid day to give myself that extra boost I need and satisfy the taste I crave!

title: This is a great mop and cleaning kit!!!!
text: To begin with, I have been using Swiffer products for years now. I guess I just I just thought they would be easier (albeit a lot more expensive) than typical mops. I readily accepted this Stainmaster mop kit thinking it was time for a change. This is a great product and works flawlessly on my tile and hardwood Florida floors. Easy to set up and use, and ergonomically fits great in my hands, I find it far easier to use than Swiffer. A simple rinse in clean water and squeezes and I am ready for the next clean up job. I have been saving easily $10 a month since I switched and I believe my floors are far cleaner than they ever were before. I will not be going back!!

title: Nature's Origin makes the best aromatherapy products out there - Mindfulness is my favorite variety!
text: Great light citrus aroma, I really love this Nature's Origin product and use it all the time when I work from home. Believe it or not, I honestly believe the aroma helps me stay alert when I work from home and it definitely keeps me calm and focused. A little goes a long way with this aromatherapy as well.

title: This is a great daily aid to increasing bone density!
text: I love Jarrow products and have been taking these Bone-Up daily supplements (as well as the Jarrow formula for joints) for well over a year now. I was diagnosed with osteoporosis last year during my annual physical (I am 61) and my doctor recommended I start taking Calcium and Vitamin D to help deter any further problems. These are easy on the stomach (I have a tendency to take these on an empty stomach in the morning with no side effects) and my body absorbs this readily. I will be going for a bone density scan again in November and I hope to see an improvement since my diagnose last year. I will update this review then.

title: Great aid to strengthening aging bones!
text: I love Jarrow products and have been taking these Bone-Up daily supplements (as well as the Jarrow formula for joints) for well over a year now. I was diagnosed with osteoporosis last year during my annual physical (I am 61) and my doctor recommended I start taking Calcium and Vitamin D to help deter any further problems. These are easy on the stomach (I have a tendency to take these on an empty stomach in the morning with no side effects) and my body absorbs this readily. I will be going for a bone density scan again in November and I hope to see an improvement since my diagnose last year. I will update this review then.

title: Great supplement to keep your body health and your joints in the best shape of your life!
text: I am a 60 something woman who was recently diagnosed with osteoporosis. I love to exercise and I walk about 5 miles a day (my 3 year old Aussie Shepherd mix assures that I do, lol). I try to do everything I can to keep my bones, muscles and joints in optimum shape so I will live a long active life. I take several Jarrow Formulas products daily, including the bone supplements and these joint builders. Easy to take, no stomach upset (even if I take them without food), these help me keep healthy and active. All natural ingredients, I can highly recommend these to anyone who works out or is rough on their body (especially runners). My 34 year old son, who is active in jui-jitsu also takes these daily. For all ages, for all stages of your life, keep your body in optimal condition by giving it what it needs to thrive.

text: I am a 60 something woman who was recently diagnosed with osteoporosis. I love to exercise and I walk about 5 miles a day (my 3 year old Aussie Shepherd mix assures that I do, lol).
