title: Great relief for painful feet!
text: These pain relief insoles are my favorites by far. Not sure how it works, but I actually do feel the stimulating sensation on my feel helping to soothe them and relieve the painful burning I feel after a full day at work on my feet.My feet actually feel relaxed and stimulated. I am very hard on my feet and use insoles of one kind or another in every pair of shoes I own (from sandals to sneakers to heels, to loafers). I like to use these in my flats as they tend to work better in loafers or sneakers than anything else. I love Dr. Scholl's products, they always seem to provide the right comfort and the right support for every shoe in my closet.

title: Great every day wear insoles!
text: I use these in all my flat shoes. Great for a day at the mall or when walking around the park with my grandkids. These fit well in my loafers (I wear size 9) and they last the whole day making my feet feel well rested and revitalized. I highly recommend these for casual wear. A must have for vacationers who plan to do a lot of sightseeing or even just for everyday wear. I don't leave home without them!

title: These are the best lower back pain relief insoles around!
text: I am on my feet all day with my job and I tend to wear some kind of heel (whether it's a wedge or a 2 inch heel). I need support and cushioning or, by the end of the day, I have terrible lower back and heel pain. I found these Pain Relief Orthotics earlier this year and I am so glad I did. Light weight, fits in my shoe perfectly for my size 9 feet, and definitely makes a major difference by the end of the day in the way my back feels. I am sure I will never be able to get rid of all the pain, but with these Dr. Scholl's insoles, I feel refreshed and not like I used to. I highly recommend these for any one on their feet (waitresses, bartenders, sales associates, etc) and I know your feet (and back) will thank you.

title: Great for dressy, open-toed shoes!
text: These are my go to insoles with my dressy heeled shoes (most of which are sandal styles). These are thin, basically invisible, and provide me with the comfort and support I need when on my feet. I use Dr. Scholl's supports in almost every pair of shoes I own. They have products, styles and varieties for every occasion and shoe type and I love all of them. My feet love Dr. Scholl's!!!!

title: A must have for yourself or for the runner in your life!
text: These are the best running insoles out there in the market today. I always keep a pair in my running shoes to help add comfort, and support, to my morning runs. I am typically very hard on my feet (and run about 6-7 miles a day) and I wouldn't do it unless I had something in my sneakers. These are light and hardly noticeable, but you will know they are there with the way your feet feel. If you are a runner, man or woman, you need to keep an insole in your shoes and this Dr. Scholl's variety is just perfect (they make them for men as well).

title: Nice heel cushions, just be sure you are not too active with your feet.
text: I have been looking for heel cushions for a while now. I walk every morning (upwards of 5 miles) and my heels typically are sore almost every day. I will say that upon inserting these in my sneakers and then putting them on, my feet felt amazing. I immediately could tell the difference in my gait. I had to deduct one star though because after wearing them and walking for upwards of an hour I felt the cushions had shifted. It became uncomfortable for the remainder of my walk. I was wondering if this was just a lark and used them as well the second day, this time using some packing tape rolled to assist in securing them in place in my sneakers. Although this did seem to solve the movement, I didn't feel I should have to adjust this myself to make them work properly. This are probably great if you don't do heavy duty exercise walking/running in them (think every day work, going to dinner or light shopping). But, doesn't seem to work well if you are very active on your feet.

title: Great dietary supplement. Good for you and tastes great, too!
text: I really liked this SANP product. The mango taste was light (not overpowering) and drinking it was very palatable (unlike other supplements I have tried in the past). I like the multi-mineral formula, especially for bone strengthening (Vitamin D, calcium, manganese). Phosphorous, potassium and vitamin C added is just icing on the cake. I am 60 years old and have been diagnosed with mild osteoporosis, so trying to strengthen bone health is very important to me. In addition, I go to the gym daily and the added potassium is important to me as well. No complaints, just good comments about this product. I will be buying more when this initial product is depleted.

title: Definitely works to try to instill healthy mouth hygiene to the youngest in your family!
text: My three year old grandbaby loves this toothpaste! It was difficult for us to get him 'committed' to brush his teeth several times a day, but when I introduced this bubble fruit flavor, I can honestly say that he actually looks forward to it! There is a part of me that feels I might be introducing a sweet reward aspect into this (not necessarily a good way to go when trying to teach a child good habits) but it works. He loves the flavor and the colorful packaging and character of the brand. Although this may be a semi-guilty way to go to encourage good, healthy habits, it does work and he loves it!

title: Good for my 60 something mind and memory
text: Truth be told, I have been taking this for about two weeks now. To be honest, I don't know anything about Cera-Q and what it does. I would have liked this combined with some other vitamins or minerals so I could reap the benefits of overall daily supplement instead of just memory. I haven't noticed anything dramatic yet, but then, I would think it must work gradual. I will say that there is no after taste or cause me any issues when I take it with juice in the morning on a relatively empty stomach and that I do feel a bit more energetic. I am giving this 4 stars because of the other glowing reviews that are out there thinking I just haven't taken it long enough yet to be far. As I have 2 month supply, I will come back towards the end to update my review with my final thoughts.

title: Nice supplement but on the pricey side
text: On the plus side, I rarely eat breakfast in the morning and I easily can take one of these with no adverse stomach or heartburn side effects. In reading the ingredients, these appear to be chock full of almost everything my 60 year old body needs to be healthy and feel energetic. I have been taking them now for two weeks and I honestly do not feel different, but I am sure it is too soon to tell. On the negative side (hence the deduction of one star), this is almost $50 for a little over 3 week supply. I find this extremely pricey and not something that I will continue taking once I have completed the bottle (unless I have a miraculous awakening that I do not feel currently). Thinking that Centrum Silver or One a Day for Women can fill most of this for a far more reasonable price.

title: Great tasting, clean mouth, but read ingredients first
text: I actually really liked this toothpaste. Great tasting and my teeth felt super clean every time I brush. I am deducting one star, and maybe I should do 2, given this has Triclosan in it. I swear I never heard of Triclosan before, but I googled it and it is scary stuff. I am hesitant to keep using the toothpaste, just hoping that Colgate has done enough research for me to feel safe using it. Just not sure if continuing to use this is worth the risk. I have a dental appt in 2 weeks, will be discussing with my doctor to see what she says.

title: Great firm holding arm sleeve for my active lifestyle
text: This arm sleeve works perfectly for my needs. I am an avid exercise enthusiast and I do find my arm muscles tired and needing support most of the time (whether weight lifting or playing tennis). This sleeve fits me well and massages and holds my muscles firmly before, after and during my workout. I honestly do not care for this pattern, it looks like a pair of yoga pants I used to own, lol. I prefer a solid color, but that is not a reason to deduct any stars from this review. I have used Futuo compression sleeves before and I will continue to use them as they meet my needs totally.

title: Good, inexpensive way to help keep your teeth in optimum health!
text: This is a good, semi-powerful flossing alternative. I typically use my Sonicare flosser (plug in chargeable) which is far stronger than this. But, then again, it was 4 times the price of this one. I would recommend this to someone who has not used these types of water pik flossers to gain practice before upgrading to a more expensive model. Also, this is a great device to travel with. I am leaving in about a month for a transatlantic cruise and this will handily stow in my suitcase (and no need for international plugs). This Conair does the job, maybe not as well as others, but for the money it's a great way to improve your teeth and gum health.

title: Scary stuff - beware!
text: WARNING - PLEASE READ LABEL OF INGREDIENTS BEFORE PURCHASING. I received this and decided to let my 31 year old son try it first. He is an avid grappling jui-jitsu athlete and works out almost nightly. He called me shortly after leaving the house in a panic state because of the feeling that had overcome him. He told me he was hot and he had the feeling of pins and needles all over his body. I panicked and wanted him to go to the hospital, but instead he headed to his gym. It was there that his fellow athletes indicated they were familiar with this product and it's ingredients and the impact it has on some people. He called me back to tell me that he was going to stay until the feeling wore off and that he heard that supposedly this feeling is 'normal' and that a lot of athletes like the 'rush'. Unfortunately, my son had an experience with fire ants when he was 7 years old which he never forgot and said that the feeling taking this Met-Rx rivaled that feeling he had years ago (when he did go to the hospital). Needless to say, this went right in the garbage when he got home. Never again. Back to using his regular pre workout nutrition..

title: Great dietary supplement, does the job.
text: New Chapter makes great products and this antioxidant and supplement will keep your immune system in check. I have been taking elderberry supplements since I hit age 55 and I have to say I haven't felt better. Not 100% sure if I can attribute it to the elderberry addition, but I will say that when I was younger I always seem to have had some sort of cold or virus at least once a year. Now, knock wood, I can say I haven't had any illnesses in over 5 years. If there is any downside to this it's the cost ($25 a month), but I guess you can't put a price on good health, especially as we age.

title: Great work out addition - chalky strong taste
text: Great product to be used as a protein supplement and for increasing muscle mass. Rating it as 4 stars as I didn't like the flavor (at all) and the consistency was too chalky with a strong aftertaste that I was only able to get rid of by rinsing out my mouth. However, if you can handle the taste, this is a great addition to your work out regimen, I am sure that younger males will find the taste palatable, I just didn't like it.

title: Not just for babies~ Fabulous!
text: With my new grandbaby coming to visit me in August, I needed to stock up on items to have here in the household for his use. At 6 months old, he is able to sit up and splash and I wanted to be sure that anything I got for use in the bath would be gentle in the event he got any in his eyes. I always use Aquaphor for my own beauty regimine, so I knew I would not be disappointed with their line of children/baby products. This shampoo and body wash smells great and it is gentle and effective in cleaning him without stinging his eyes. I also love the silky feel this left not only on his delicate skin, but also on my hands as well. He left here last Saturday and I have moved this into my own bathroom to use in my shower routine for myself. What a great product for babies and adults as well. I will be buying more soon!

title: Hefty out does itself again!
text: I absolutely love these new Hefty Gripper tall trash bags. In the past, I often have had drawstrings (do to the weight of the bag) stretch out and often break. Because of this, I have a tendency to underfill my trashbags and therefore ultimately use more of them ($$). Kudos to Hefty for coming up with this gripper bags. First, they hug my trash can which prevents them from collapsing within the pail when I drop something a little heavy in them. Secondly, they are made super strong, so I no longer fear the ripping of a drawstring on my way to the trash can. I always love Hefty products and use them almost exclusively, but this new Gripper model is really fantastic and out does all the others!

title: I love this body wash for my grandbaby (and for me, too)!
text: I have used this Johnson's Baby wash at least half a dozen times with my 3 year old grandson since receiving it.I love the way it makes his skin feel and he is head to toe clean. No need for shampoo, this body wash does it all. And if he gets in his eyes (which he often does when splashing in the tub) there is no irritation at all. I love the fragrance, not strong at all, and it keeps him smelling clean and fresh all day. I have no complaints about this product. You can always rely on J&J products for delivering quality every time! I also don't feel this is necessarily for babies as I could feel the skin on my hands after bathing getting smoother and smelling lovely as well. Kudos Johnson's!

title: Kowabunga! Kids love it!!!!
text: I decided to get this for my soon to be three year old grandson to try. What a hit! The minute I opened the package he went running to brush his teeth. His mother, my daughter-in-law, told me how painful it was in the past to get him to brush his teeth several times a day. Since he started using the TMNT talking toothbrush, it makes a cumbersome chore now fun to do. I know some others on here have talked about the fact that it is only good for 3-6 months. But, honestly, for less than $8, it's well worth the price to replace it. I plan to get a new one for him for Christmas and put it as a stocking stuffer. This is a great idea to get kids to now want to brush their teeth.

title: Great mouthwash, alcohol free!
text: To be honest, I have been using ACT Restoring mouthwash for years now. But, after reading reviews on Colgate Total Repair and seeing it offered, I jumped on it. I typically use mouthwash twice a day (morning and before going to bed), but I have found ACT tends to give me dry mouth overnight which I know is not good for my enamel and plaque build up. Well, I have been using Colgate Total Daily Repair for a week now, and I guess because it is alcohol free, I am not having the same issues I had with ACT. Plus, I love the taste of this mouthwash and how fresh my mouth feels after using. I am now a firm Colgate customer now and have already purchased another bottle at the market last Sunday for use after this bottle is done. Kudos Colgate!

title: Love this instant clotting technology! Works like a charm!
text: These are great bandages. First time I used one, I had just been slicing vegetables for dinner and cut my index finger. For some reason, whenever I slice my finger in that area, maybe because my chef's knife is so sharp, the wound is deep and the blood never seems to stop. Typically, I am wrapping a paper towel around it and pressing it for what seems to be ages and then, when I take it off, the blood seems to start up again. Anyway, first bandage I tried was after my last cut. I did first press the spot for a bit separately, but then immediately put the band-aid on. At a less than 3 inch size, this bandage did the trick. Bleeding stopped and my finger was attractively covered in a brand new band-aid. I guess I never knew this instant clotting technology existed and I am totally sold. I am going to look for a large size to keep in my medicine cabinet for other uses as well.

title: Just love, love, love this new Gain Duets Scent Booster!
text: I love using scent boosters in my laundry, and now that Gain is starting to produce them, I am hooked. This wildflower and waterfall scent is delightful, light, pleasant and stays in my sheets  for days in using them (I would assume they do the same in regular laundry, but I wash those with each wear). Gain is a product name you can rely on for great quality, so I knew I would love this when I ordered it. Kudos, Gain, for making another great product!

title: Great supplement for good eye and heart health
text: I must mention up front that I do tend to take my vitamins in the morning, usually when I wake up and before I eat something. I had no problems with this MegaRed Omega-3. I was worried about a fishy after taste or something 'repeating' back up with an unpleasant taste. But, surprisingly, I was able to take this and had no side effects on an empty stomach. These are great for heart and eye health and I strongly recommend them for folks (like me) over 50 years old to use as a daily supplement. Easy to swallow and digests quickly.

title: Good product for that extra push towards an ageless skin
text: As others have mentioned, it is a little difficult to really see a difference, particularly in just a few weeks of use. I am taking this in conjunction with another Nature's Bounty product (Ageless Eye) and all I can say is 'so far, so good'. I think I see and feel my skin feeling more hydrated than before. Fine lines do appear to be diminished. However, as others said, I use this with topical moisturizing products as well, so I am rating it as 4 stars. To be honest, I feel it can't hurt me and my body can always use nutrients in any form or fashion. I typically take this in the morning, on an empty stomach with no adverse side effects. I exclusively use Nature's Bounty for their vitamin products, and have been quite pleased with their quality.

title: Another wonderful product from the All family of laundry detergents!
text: I love All products and this new Oxi formula is no exception. I find it brightens my colors and my whites perfectly (even when I wash them in a single load). In addition,  a little goes a long way in my top loading HE machine. I love the fragrance as well and it does not interfere with my fabric softener at all. No complaints, just kudos for another great product.

title: I love Snuggle - only brand I use
text: I exclusively use Snuggle as my brand of choice in fabric softeners. Not only is economical to use (a little goes a long way in my HE machine), but my clothes come out soft and smelling wonderful. When used on my bedding, I can smell the fresh scent days into use. I highly recommend Snuggle for everyone. Great size product, great price and the best on the market when it comes to softening and freshening everything.

title: Great strong kitchen garbage bags with odor control
text: First, I need to state that I live alone. So, my garbage goes out only twice a week (to coincide with trash pickup). I love that these bags have antimicrobial protection which helps to keep my garbage smells under control (I typically use onion and garlic in a lot of my cooking). They are also just as strong as the Hefty cinch bags I typically buy. So, with these, I get the best of both worlds: strength and odor control. Great economical size, will last the average household months.

title: Great support wrap for the active!
text: Great for all around support. I tend to get some carpal tunnel on my hand/wrist so I have used this to support my wrist while working on the computer. I am not crazy about the black coloring, prefer the beige (so it is not quite as noticeable), but it is all good. I also have wrapped my right knee with this (worn under pants) when I feel I need it when out for prolonged walks. Nice 80 inch length so I can make several uses out of this roll, strong and self-sticking. No complaints, does what it should (you can always rely on ACE for quality products). Highly recommend.

title: 20 day supply - Gummy vitamins
text: Great multi vitamin, comparable to Emergen-C. Tastes good (and thank goodness it does as you need to take 3 of these a day). Others here have listed ingredients, so I will not repeat. I have no complaints with this product, with the exception of the price. Typically, I will buy a bottle of vitamins to obtain a one or two month supply. With this Vitafusion you only get 20 days worth (20 days X 3 gummies a day). To me, I can get a better supply of multivitamins at much less cost which will last me twice as long. I have nothing bad to say about the product itself, just that I think you can do better with another brand.

title: Best pods and detergent overall on the market today!
text: I need to start by saying I love Arm and Hammer products. Usually, they are economical and you definitely get more for your dollar over other brands. These pods are no exception. They are cheaper on Amazon than they are in my local Florida market (Publix/Winn Dixie), when you can find them. They are far more convenient than messy powders or liquids where you tend to use too much. They also clean better. With their combination of baking soda and oxiclean, my laundry (whites and colors) comes out cleaner than with any other detergent I have tried. Nothing but kudos for this product!

title: Great paper towels!
text: First time using Plenty paper towels. I do find them absorbent and the sheet size was full (I honestly prefer the paper towels that allow you to choose your own size so with smaller messes there is no need to use a full sheet). These are absorbent and soft. Not sure how cost effective they are as the current product page on Amazon shows unavailable and they do not sell Plenty in the stores. Nice paper towel, does the job well.

title: I love this non-mess way of cooking on the grill! Perfect!!
text: I had never tried these before getting them from Amazon. What an amazing idea! I love to make roasted potatoes on the grill (cubed potatoes, onions, peppers, olive oil, rosemary) and usually have to put them in an open pan since fear of the olive oil pouring into the fire has always kept me from just using plain Reynolds Wrap. This handy way to use foil is just perfect. Nothing spills, and clean up is a breeze (no more having to wash the pan). I also used one for salmon on the grill (lemon and rosemary) and it turned out perfect as well. I love these wraps and will be using them on the grill from now on.

title: Charmin quality and this economic size package just can't be beat!
text: Great basic toilet paper, really liked it better than the new 'stronger' variety they are advertising. Great economical size, too, and it's great to have Amazon deliver this stuff straight to your door (no need to be carrying it home from the market. Charmin always makes a great toilet paper. I know I have read in the past that there were issues with Charmin clogging toilets and septic systems but evidently, those issues have been resolved. Good to go with a name you trust for quality and the economical size is just great for any family's need!

title: Don't neglect your colon health. Great probiotic supplement!
text: I have used these Vitamin World Probiotics before, and I wanted to try them again. These are easy to swallow, no after taste, and I often take them on an empty stomach with no impact. These work great and truly help with my regularity. If i wanted to deduct any stars at all it would be because of the price. I have found excellent generics at GNC and even Phillips Colon Health which work equally well at a lesser expensive price. Excellent product though, made with quality ingredients and easy to take and digest.

title: No complaints only kudos (so far)
text: After reading other lower rated reviews out here, I hesitated giving this 5 stars. But as I have been using it consistently for over a week now, I have seen no problems. So, to be fair to Philips I am rating this as I see it currently. If anything changes where this unit fails, I will edit and update my review and rating. For now, I absolutely love this flosser. I am usually a random (not regular) flosser and use floss. I hate using it as it tends, in my opinion, not do the job adequately unless I spend a lot of time doing it. Now that I am using this Sonicare, I love how it feels and works. I fill the reservoir with mouthwash (this comes with a sample of Sonicare mouthwash, but I prefer and use ACT) and the air pop easily pops and pumps mouthwash between my teeth and gums (which makes my rinsing far more effective than swishing alone). I found debris come from between my teeth that I am sure has been there for a while but thanks to Philips is there no more. I actually find this fun to use and am using it twice daily now when I normally brush my teeth (something I never did when flossing manually). Yes, my gums bled the first few times I used it, but since then I have not seen the same impact so I know my mouth is far healthier.

title: Great looking accurate scale!
text: Beautiful and functional, this BalanceFrom is the best on the market today for accuracy and home decor. I absolutely love this scale. Easy to set up an looks great in my bathroom.

title: Terrific batteries, no complaints
text: Great alkaline, long lasting batteries. I love buying in bulk from Amazon. Prime delivery, you can't go wrong. Kudos to Rayovac and Amazon for another excellent buying experience!

title: My favorite trash bags!
text: I love Glad trash bags. Always to me the best value for the money. They are strong and hold up to a lot of punishment (I often just set the bag of trash out by the curb in lieu of using a garbage can and I have yet to see any critters rip into it).

title: Best laundry detergent on the market!
text: I love Era. Buy it a few times a year from Amazon using Subscribe and Save. Great smelling, deep cleaning, and works great with my fabric softener for long lasting freshness. I also like this particular size of laundry detergent as it doesn't take up too much room, but it condensed to last a long time. No complaints, just love!

title: I love Scott tissue!
text: Out of all the toilet paper in the world, I must admit I like Scott Tissue the best. I hate that really soft 'squeezable' stuff (like Charmin), for some reason the feel of that TP makes me shiver (it's like cotton in my finger nails). Anyway, I subscribe and save this Scott from Amazon. I love the fact that I can get it delivered right to my door and I don't have to lug it home from the Supermarket. Great toilet paper, a roll lasts a long time, it's durable and doesn't have that weird cottony feel.

title: Wonderful product, use it in every laundry load!
text: I love the Downy Unstopables and use them almost exclusively in my laundry. I love the way my sheets smell and how much it adds to the length of time they smell fresh and clean!

title: My menagerie and my husband thank you, Downey, for another great product!
text: Absolutely love this Downy Fresh Protect. First, want to mention I have also (and still) use the Unstoppables as well. However, I like to use this Fresh Protect on my bedding when I do the laundry. I have a cat and a dog who will make it to the bed (at some point during the night) and to be honest as often as I wash sheets and comforters, I always feel like the freshly washed smell goes away too quickly with my household. I have now used the Fresh Protect on bedding laundry three times and I can absolutely attest to the fact that Fresh Protect out does all the others. I am sold and will be using this from now on. I cannot attest to any of the other fragrances in this line, but I will say this blossom is unique, light and makes my sheets smell (and feel) like they just came out of the dryer days later. Kudos Downy!

title: Great boost to your metabolism and overall well-being!
text: I have been using these Tapout supplements for about 2 weeks now. Maybe not long enough to give a solid review. However, I will say that I do feel better and feel more energized all day (not just during my runs or my lifting sessions)). It's obvious that the vitamins and minerals are targeted to enhance your overall health. I would honestly recommend these even to people who don't exercise a lot (just for the rewarding stabilization of health and overall metabolism). Only downside is that don't take them on an empty stomach. First time I took them it was first thing in the morning before I had eaten something and I was sorry I did. Subsequent to that experience, I tried a single banana and again felt a little nauseous. I now am eating cereal and fruit (which I guess I was lacking) and the supplements work great. Please eat before taking.

title: Best toothbrush on the marked today!
text: Best toothbrush on the market. I had one of these for several years and it broke. I am a vine member and got a different kind of Phillips as part of the program (something with ultrasonic cleaning capability) and I hated it. Used it for about 2 months and then I finally broke down and bought this. I have used it now for a week and my teeth and gums are sparkling clean. I love the Sonicare Elite models. You need to get one of these toothbrushes if you love your teeth! Don't settle for less.

title: Great laundry detergent for a mixed batch of colored laundry
text: Great detergent for my HE top loading machine. Clothes smell fresh, come out clean, and colors are incredibly vibrant. I did do a little test with a brand new navy blue t-shirt that hadn't been washed yet. I threw in an old white sock along with other dark colors just to see if the t-shirt would bleed on the socks. Of course, I can't prove that the shirt would have bled without the Tide Colorguard, but I can say that the sock came out as white as it went in. So, I think this Tide product does live up to it's name and as usual, you can rely on the Tide name for a great quality product. Kudos to Procter and Gamble!

title: Perfect for many uses!!!
text: Great bags and great for multiple purposes. Not only are they great for refrigerated foods (cheese, fruits, vegetables) but I find them great for freezing food as well (works best if you squeeze all the air out before sealing the bag). Needless to say, they also work well for lunch bag use (although they may be a little large unless you are storing more than one sandwich). However, most of all I also love these for storing small items around the house. I have bags of nails and picture hangers in these out in the garage, spools of threads and pins in my laundry room, I use them in the bathroom for small cosmetic items and hair pins and the smaller children use them for crayons and picture puzzle pieces. I honestly can't say enough about the versatility and the great variety of things you can do with these Ziploc slider bags. Every house should have at least one box of them available at all times. Can be used for so many purposes.

title: Well worth the expense for your health
text: Gum disease is one of the leading causes of other body diseases an doctors and dentists have continued to stress the importance of flossing. I hate using regular string floss and have previously used the Waterpik Ultra model. I love this new model from Waterpik, I love the size, the set up, the quietness and the modern appearance it has sitting on my bathroom vanity. It flosses amazing and when I first used it I found a lot of bleeding with my gums, but now having used it for almost two weeks now daily, my gums are not bleeding. And my mouth feels incredibly clean and fresh. I highly recommend this flosser to anyone who hates the drudgery of flossing. Waterpik actually makes a mundane, but critical, task fun and attractive. Kudos!!!

title: Great product! Love it!
text: I want to start by saying I have been using Philips electric toothbrushes for years and I love them. When I saw this flosser, I jumped on it. Quality of Philips' products can't be beat, and I can honestly say the flosser is incredible. I absolutely hate flossing and this electric flosser makes what could be a burdensome chore, fun and quick. My teeth have never felt so clean and my mouth so fresh since I have been using it for the last 2+ weeks. I have made the use of this flosser part of my everyday evening routine and my gums look wonderful (they did do some bleeding at first but most of that has stopped with continued use). I highly recommend the Philips Sonicare flosser for everyone. Would make a great Christmas present!

title: Works as it should
text: Jet Dry is a great product, I have used it for years. This is the first time I tried the Turbo Dry and I have used it for at least 7 washloads of dishes since I received it. I was particularly impressed with the way my glasses turned out, sparkling and spot free. I found all my dishes clean and totally dry. To be honest, I don't notice the difference between the regular and the turbo, and they are typically the same price. Either one will do the trick and do it well. After years of just using Cascade or another detergent alone, once I found the difference using a good drying agent I will never go back to doing loads of dishes without it again. No wiping, no getting rid of spotting, perfect everytime!

title: Nice clean up set - could be a little taller
text: The OXO Good Grips does what it is intended to do. I have used it continuously since receiving it on my hard wood floors. One area where the sweep set works very well is around cat litter. I have a cat who does like to track litter out of the box and I find the broom fine and perfectly adjusted in cleaning up the area with just a few strokes. If I had any complaint at all it would be in the height. I am almost 5'8" and I do have to bend over slightly when using it (which is not comfortable for me). I would say for someone 5'4" or less, this would be a next to perfect set. Would also make a unique housewarming or bridal shower add on gift (as an alternative to the toasters and blenders people normally would buy).

title: Not sure what this does.. don't waste your money

I am not even sure what it is supposed to do, but it certainly doesn't clean them better (still occasionally have crusted foods on my dishes if I don't prewash) or reduce spots on glasses. title: Love my Sonicare - You can rely on the name for quality!
text: This is my third Sonicare electric toothbrush in probably the last 7-8 years. I love their dependability and quality (you can always count on the Sonicare name). I have actually just gotten back from a two week vacation in Europe and brought the toothbrush with me (without the charging stand) to save on minimal weight and space in my luggage. I actually thought it would run out of the charge at some point and I would have to use it 'un-electrified'. To my surprise, even after using the brush a minimum of twice a day, the Sonicare 5600 maintained the charge. The carrying case was compact and protective and actually made the portability of the toothbrush an ease. As far as the teeth cleaning goes, I love Sonicare. My teeth always feel dentist-fresh twice a day and I know that my check-ups have improved greatly over the years by using Sonicare in contrast to other toothbrushes. I highly reccommend this toothbrush to everyone. Holds a charge, cleans teeth flawlessly and will last for years.

title: Better than the regular white strips, but not like a dentist
text: Let me start by saying, these are much better than the standard white strips (which I have used several times). The old/standard whitening strips never stuck to my teeth properly and with a little saliva, were off my teeth in no time. These new 3D strips are a vast improvement over the older ones and do stay on my teeth longer (they actually seem to grip the teeth). The whitening was good as well, but certainly not like a professional whitening at a dentist office. The price of these is higher than the older ones ($40 vs $20s), but $100s of dollars less an alternative dental visit. So better, might be good in a quick fix, but not optimal.

title: Wet or Dry - Great shave
text:
It had been many years since I have used an electric razor. Normally my Norelco's were around the $40-60 price range and would last (battery/blades) about 2-3 years. I'd change out the blades if the battery hung on and use the razor a bit longer.
Since I was getting this as Christmas Gift for myself and we are living in the Motorhome during the snowy cold part of the season in Colorado I decided to return to an electric I could also use in the shower once we move into our house in a few months.
We have to take Navy showers (6 gal water heater). scrinping on hot water.

I like not having to set closeness of the razor and still getting a close shave.
- the charge lasted me almost a month before having to recharge the battery. (usually only takes about 2 - 3 minutes to shave).
- Clean up was fairly easy, only issue is one of the heads doesn't always stay open when i'm brushing out the hair.
- it takes up less space on the counter then previously.
- very nice carrying case
- charges up quickly, if needed, but if you leave it on it will charge and (to me) seems to hold the charge better/longer.
- using it with a wet beard was a piece of cake, even if its an all weekend beard on Monday AM.

I have not used shaving cream with this unit yet and next weekend I plan to use the solution to clean up the razor.

so far this has been worth the money spent on it, even if I picked it out myself for Christmas.
Wife is happy w/ the closeness of the shave.

title: Carbona Oven Cleaner
text:
Ok... first the details, my range is brand new. I cooked literally ONE meal (whole chicken that dropped some grease). I did NOT cook ANYTHING in the oven after that meal in order to clean it without making it on even worse. And yes, my range does have a "self clean" option - but after a professional appliance repair guy told me never to use this option because it over heats all the electronics, which significantly shortens the life of your range - I won't use it. Besides, it doesn't work any way - I have "hidden elements." So the best the self cleaning does is heat up water, make steam and "cleans" about as good as this cleaner. After all of that prep info here is the review on this cleaner:
PRO
* The cleaner is sort of gel and DOES stay in place (but it doesn't do anything so.. is this a pro??)
* It does have an slight odor - faintly like bleach

CON
* The directions suggest that you could possibly clean after it sits for "20 minutes," however, if you have baked on sugar or grease you will need a 4 HOUR sit - I went through TWO 4 hour stints.. with SUPER SUPER rubbing with a scrub pad. I was able to make a dent, but not fully clean the oven. Check photos I have included. 20 minutes?? I cannot imagine WHAT this would clean in 20 minutes, let alone 8 hours.
* Then they suggest you'll be able to just wipe and sponge. However, if you have those pesky sugar or grease areas, you may need a "scrub sponge"... Yeah. You're gonna need a full scrub pad, strong knees and a LOT of elbow grease and I ain't kidding. Even after TWO 4 hour sessions - that's 8 hours of sitting and then about 2 hours of scrubbing - it was very, very disappointing. Please see photos.
* I was hoping the second 4 hour session - it might be easier. But it was not, not even a tiny bit.

It doesn't suggest using gloves but I used them. I followed their directions (see photo) exactly. I was really hopeful, but I tossed this cleaner right in the trash. Hot water would have been as effective - and only with super, super scrubbing. Also I want to say that my range was totally brand new. The grease happened on the very first time I used the oven and I immediately STOPPED using the oven to be sure I wasn't making the grease area worse. Can you imagine if you tried this on a range that had been used more than once?? If you need to clean your oven, pass on this - unless you love frustration and have a world of time to waste. Eh. Super, super big waste of time AND money.

Perhaps it will work more effectively over time.  Overall, it feels like at the very least it may help with circulation and it feels nice.  At the best, it will help with my plantar fasciitis. title: Teslong ear wax remover
text:
I have always had a wax issue - since I was a very small child. And my old country doctor told me "Do NOT stick anything smaller than your elbow into your ear. Ever." I have gone to an Ear Nose Throat doc to get the wax removed for years. The virus has caused me to seek out alternatives for some optional care - this being one. My ENT has a handy "vacuum" tool I wish I could get my hands on - but no luck on that - yet. That vacuum is so fast and painless. Back in the day they would flush my ears with warm water - that REALLY hurts - I have an inner condition (dual endo-lymphatic hydrops - NOT Meiners) - this adds to discomfort of a water wash. Then came the drops and other ear additives that never worked and in some cases were also painful. I also tried a little plastic scoop that had a protective stop ring so you can not insert it too far into the canal - but I couldn't see what I was doing or where to even reach! I just wanted to outline what I have tried before this tool. I considered this tool and a spiral spinner type for this purchase. The spinner version had such a mixed bag of reviews, I went this way - even though this one is a bit more of an investment.
First, you will need to download software onto your android or Iphone. There are access requests, but you can totally deny what you don't want it access. I allowed storage only. Still works perfectly.

PROS
- The camera is bright and very clear. You can easily see what you need to. *who knew there were so many little fine hairs on your ear walls! I am super amazed at how clear the camera is.
- It comes with 4 heads that easily attach to the camera end. *NOTE It's going to take a bit of practice to become effective with use. It's a little like when you're looking in a mirror and the opposite direction.. It's taking me some time - but I am going to persevere. Also includes 3 ear scope tips.
- Comes with a hard case, zipper close case that has stretchy mesh inside to keep all the pieces in place and clean.
- Comes with a starter supply of alcohol swabs for cleaning and some really tiny qtips for cleaning the implements.
- Comes with a charging/attach to your phone cord AND adapters for both android and Iphones. (I have an android - Samsung Galaxy 10+ - works seamlessly.
- Comes with an easy to follow and understand mini manual and FAQs.
- It charges up very quickly and lasts longer (in my opinion) than you need it to.
- Overall, it's extremely easy to understand and use (but you will need to practice for success)

NEUTRAL
- on the app download description there is a lot of Asian writing (Chinese I am assuming) and little English - AND there are so far only 12 (TWELVE) reviews of the app. However, the app loaded on my phone quickly and is 100% English - but in fairness there is little to read or understand as the camera just starts as you're using it. Also, it is "verified" by Playstore - so I feel it's fairly ok at this point.
- The tips are just long enough to reach the waxy area - but be careful not to insert any further into your ear - there is no stopper protection to stop you from pushing too far into your ear canal. In all honesty, the camera should help to stop you from inserting too far if you're paying attention. The camera view is very, very clear - but it is tricky to use - requires practice.

CONS
- I am a klutz and it's taking longer than I would like to be successful - BUT I can see the light at the end of the tunnel (ha) and the possibility of success. It might be too hard for some and I would not recommend for older folks to use on their own - unless they have help.
- the attachment scoops need to be securely and carefully attached - if not, they can become unattached and you have to fish it out. I did not have this issue, but I didn't attach properly and it fell off as I removed the camera - fortunately outside of my ear. After that - I carefully and securely attach the tips.

At this time I am very happy with my purchase - however, having said this I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: bite away tool
text: I waited to review this tool until I had an occasion to use it. And I will admit I was super skeptical.  I react to mosquito, sand fly, bees, etc more than the usual person - have epi pen for bees. Per my doctor I am unusually reactive to insect bites.  I got a bite (NOT a bee sting)... not sure by what - it was on the under side of my wrist.  I wish I would have taken before and after shots because it was amazing.  First, the pen/tool is unusual.  It's something new to use - so after rereading the instructions and trying a few times, I got it done.  When applying the tool be prepared it will feel HOT - but it doesn't burn.  Now if you used it over and over and over on the same spot without stopping - you might be able to harm yourself.  And they do note if you have any conditions that lower your sensitivity to pain or feeling - don't use this tool.  Having said all of that - there is a slight learning curve and then you get it.  I was surprised at the heat - I guess I wasn't sure what it feel like - but once I knew that was the process and that it didn't really hurt - maybe slightly uncomfortable for a second or two - it was easy.  The result is amazing.  The redness, swelling and itching that came with it was almost immediately reduced.  I did reuse it about 3 times in about 5 minutes for complete relief from the itching.  It is the following morning.  I can barely see the bite and it is not red or itchy at all.  Period.  THAT is a miracle for me.  I usually itch and swell for days and days.  It's just misery.  I THINK I may have found something that will make my life a lot more tolerable.  Hooray!  I am so excited about it.  I may purchase one of these for my sister who has the same kind of reactions I do to insect bites.  A couple of notes:  This tool does NOT prevent or stop you from catching insect born diseases - and it is slightly uncomfortable with the heat - but partly because you don't know what to expect.  That is quickly solved with correct use. I recommend just trying it on your skin once to prepare for the sensation.  I keep the directions rubberbanded to the tool so that I never forget how to use it - but with summer here and more time on front deck - I'll be using it a lot.  Right now, if I could give it 10 stars I would.  I am going to try and get a before and after photo to add to my review.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new information seem useful.

title: Bar keepers friend 3 pak
text: Three pak - bar keepers friend is good for all kinds of cleaning challenges - I purchased for a brand new set of stainless cookware.  But in this day - it's hard to get cleaning supplies of any kind locally.  So this method was greatly appreciated.

title: medline clear gloves
text: Hard to get right now and I do appreciate these as I have a skin condition that makes it necessary for me to use if I am going to come in contact with certain things. They are sort of clear... and easy to slide on and off.

title: Peri bottle
text: Way cheaper than a bidet and they don't work really well for women any way.  This, does.  Because you can "direct" the water, in the right direction (away from areas you do NOT want waste to flow like a bidet does - if you know what I mean) and a clean rinse.  In this day and age of TP hoarders, this IS useful - even if you're long past the birthing age!  Comes with a nice travel bag.  Easy to clean.  It's an option girls.  Really.

title: gift tissue paper
text: Brightly colored tissue paper and quite a lot of it.  Several pieces of each color.

title: gift bag
text: Very pretty - Hallmark quality.  Has a nice card envelope inside of the bag.  The handles are ribbon like material.  The colors are vibrant and pleasant.  I am pleased with my purchase.  For these days - it arrived quickly and in good shape with some other items I ordered. On the down side, no card, no tissue.  So plan to buy those additionally.

title: spoon straws
text: These are great for smoothies... I would like paper straws to work as well.. but they don't.  Bright colors.. less important to me - function is more to me.

title: glass top cleaner with scrubber and scraper
text: If you have a glass top stove - you NEED this cleaner.  I've had a glass top for about 20 years.  This brand is the ONLY cleaner that actually works.  Glass tops are work - they "sound" good - and they are great - but cleaning is a challenge on occasion - the scrubber and scraper are good.  The scrubber - so so - but you WILL need the razor scraper.

title: glass top cleaner
text: Good for in between the white pasty stuff... It does a fairly good job on the glass top - but it doesn't really do much with anything baked on - so you'll need to scrape or scrub that off first.

title: Dawn ultra
text: It smells clean and citrusy... works as you would expect Dawn products to..  just a shame that it has to be too expensive with hoarding.

title: rinse aid
text: Super hard to get in these times... not sure why this would be a hoarding item.. I was glad to get it here.  Finish rinse aid is, in my opinion, a must have for all dishwashers and works the best.

title: 7th gen toilet bowl cleaner
text: Works great.  And was all I could get my hands on in these crazy hoarder days.  I am sharing with my neighbors.  If you get some, please share

title: New Life hand sanitizer
text: I can't believe my luck at finding this and being able to order it.  It is 70% alcohol which is what the cdc recommends.  I have shared my order with some elderly neighbors and kept one for myself.  I really hope they can keep this available - more so than the bigger name brands - as I will be a loyal buyer.  The challenge in these days is keeping up with demand and counteracting the hoarder actions.  If you get some, please share.

title: small food storage containers
text: I have purchased these in the past - and I come back to buy them.  They do say they are reusable, washable, microwavable (never microwave plastic items), OK to freeze, etc.. however - they have a shelf life.  They won't last like the thicker, better made food storage items - but you can get a few uses out them.  Their Achilles heel are really the lids - they break easily when trying to remove them.  So there is a learning curve in placing and removing the lids.  They are sort of clear.  So you can identify the contents.  You can write on them with permanent markers.  All in all for the price and how long they survive (about a 6-12 uses) I think they are a reasonable purchase. I buy all three sizes - but the medium size is the one I run out of first.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: AA Energizer batteries
text: Have 2 grandsons and lots of stuff that require batteries so when I get to the big box store, this is how I stock up.  Energizer is the best in my opinion.

title: AA Lith batteries
text: These are a good price and the Lith batteries last a bit longer than others.  The AA size is the one we seem to use the most. All in all I felt the price was good as well.

title: Nature made calcium
text: Nature Made is the best you can buy in my opinion... no matter which supplement - I purchased these for my older neighbor.

title: Omeprazole  Amazon basic care brand
text: This is a great price and works every bit as good as the other generic brand.  And easier to get - right to your door.

title: Shout Advanced Stain remover
text: There is NOTHING better to remove set in stains.  Even those who have been washed and dried several times.  It is my go to stain remover.  Very hard to find in stores.  I grab it whenever I can.

title: Lavender essential oil
text: One of the best ones I've smelled.  Love it.  Comes with a dropper top.  Works great on my wool dryer balls.  Sometimes I drop a few in my tub for my evening bath.  I would buy this again.  Great price for the size of the bottle in my opinion.

title: wool dryer balls
text: I purchased these to replace a 4 year old set I had. I did purchase some lavender essential oil to try this go around.  I'll circle back with info on that.

title: Meclizine

title: deep clean freak
text: I purchased this hoping it would be a really good grease cutter.  Eh. The pump nozzle is good if you have a hard to reach area - but all in all - it's not the best grease cutter... disappointed over all.

title: Shout Advanced ultra gel
text: This stuff is a MIRACLE for set in (gone through the dryer) stains.  I have not found a single thing that works as well.  Lots of stuff slips through.  This is the thing that will save you.  I've even used it on stuff that's gone through several loads and STILL removed the stain.  Yup.  It's THAT good.  But... good luck finding it store shelves - even before the virus.  Get it where and while you can!

title: Vertagone oil
text: I have tried other versions/brands of this to help with dizziness and vertigo.  One thing that is disappointing about this particular brand is the application.  Best to apply to the back of ear - just behind the ear lobe.  This brand is a dropper style bottle so I end up dropping some onto a q-tip or like and then applying.  The other brand I prefer and seems to work just as well in a roller tip bottle - less waste  - thus removing one star on review.  MUCH easier to apply and use.  In my personal opinion they both work about the same - so it comes down to how you like to apply it.  If you have issues with vertigo (I have an inner ear condition - dual endolymphatic hydrops - but NOT with Meineres) it's worth a shot.

title: woolite dark laundry tabs

They are ok... the tab inside of the really awful, cheap plastic tubing smells like lavender oil.. however the edges of the cheap plastic tubes are very sharp and have pokey pieces that stick out on them... title: oceanspray cranberry chews
text: I purchased these because UTIs are a issue for me .. they were when I was younger and now as I am older, it's a bit different - but still an issue.  I've tried several different 'methods' including prescriptions for hormone creams.  Eh.  I have just purchased these so I cannot really report that they have made any difference, but I am willing to hope. So my review will so far be one of taste, size and cost.  I have included a photo of the actual gummy.  They are pretty big (about 3/4"x3/4")  and very sticky.  These chews are quite tart, despite the sugar content - which one would expect.  Cranberries are very tart!  There is sugar involved, but no artificial sweeteners and on the box, no artificial flavors, colors or preservatives.  All really important to me.  Each gummy is reported to be 'more than a glass of cranberry juice.'  Significantly less sugar than that glass of cranberry juice.  They recommend one chew in the morning and another at night for 'extended support.'  If you take 2 per day, the box of 28 is a two week supply.  In my opinion they are very, very expensive.  I am going to research some other supply options due to the cost.  I would think it will take some time, perhaps a year, to be able to properly evaluate the effectiveness of these chews.  I would also like to see where the cranberries are sourced - hopefully all USA.  The box did come with a sticker saying that the chews need to be used by 3/2020 on a sticker that had been placed over the actual box expiration.  I did peel it off and it appears to to match the larger, easier to read sticker.  Because the chews are so very expensive, I had to take 2 stars off - it's just crazy too much.  Having said all of this I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review was helpful to you.

title: Broom and dustbin set
text: We just had all our carpet removed and hard flooring installed throughout our home.  This radically changes how you clean!  The vacuum cleaner doesn't work quite the same... a broom and dust pan is so handy now!  I also use a robot vacuum cleaner now - it has a bar that is more useful for floor cleaning.  This set is awesome.  Stands in a corner in a hallway - easy to get to  - out of the way.  Took about 3 minutes to put together - easy - just twist in the lengths of handles.  The broom attaches to the dust pan, so they are always together.  No more bending over to gather the dust/dirt. That part is also nice.  I just like that I can quickly sweep up something.  The bin is easy to empty and wipe out.  The bin is plastic, the handles feel like metal.  The bristles of the broom are plastic - and it does a fair job of sweeping quick little messes.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope the info I have shared today is helpful to you.

I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this review was helpful to you!

title: microfiber mop
text: Just had all the carpet in my house removed and installed vinyl "wood" floor, so I needed this. I wanted something that was washable/reusable - this fit the bill.  I love the length and width of this mop... does a great job - fast!  The handle length is adjustable.  I separately purchased a spray cleaner to use and I have not yet used it.  So far I am just using it like a dust stick.  The mop section is washable and quickly attaches and detaches.  So far, I couldn't be happier.  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.

title: 3 pk theraworx

I prefer the spray - but my husband likes the foam - he thinks it's easier to spread evenly.  I like the spray as I think I can get more of concentrated area.  So to each his own.

title: method laundry soap
text: My mom's favorite and this scent is very difficult to get locally for some reason.  I love that I can send it directly to her door.  Method is very concentrated and works well for general cleaning.

title: battery water flosser
text: I wanted an easy water flosser for travel and this one is great.  It's easy to pack and use.  No excuses now.

title: blood sugar meter

title: fit wash fruit wash

title: sleeping mask
text: I purchased these because I get migraines... it is really important to block the light.  These are very comfortable - they completely block the light... the edges are soft the eye pockets are perfect... no pressing on your eyes or eye lash touching.  The nose piece is molded and comfortable.  The head wrap is adjustable with hook and loop strip with a wide range of tightness options.  I prefer to have it pretty loose as tightness is problem during a headache.  It stays in place -  as I move very little during a headache.  If you're sleeping in it - and roll away a fair bit, you may want to tighten it up.  You receive two masks.. I received 1 black and 1 turquoise mask.  The masks are a formed foam/foam like material and covered with the nylon like material.  The bands with the adjustable hook and loop strip are elastic - and very stretchy. Both straps are black on both masks.  I think they would be really great for travel and for people who work night shift and need to sleep in the day.  I am personally impressed with the comfort and ease of use of these masks.  However, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful - and I hope this was helpful to you!

title: canvas bags
text: I purchased these for an art project involving painting rocks for a tic tac toe game.  Use a sharpie to make the board on the outside of the bag, paint the rocks (I live on the beach in Northern Oregon - so that was a fun part of this project  - however, in all honesty - I did purchase some back up rocks in case I couldn't score the right rocks on the beach) and then paint the X's and O'x on the rocks.  I let them dry, sprayed them with sealer and VIOLE!  Tic Tac Toe - one my 5 year old grandson's favorite games.  The bag then stores the rock game pieces.  Each bag has a drawstring style pull tie. The "spare" purchased rocks will be painted and added to my rock garden that now has a mixture of agates, jasper and other rocks I found interesting in the past 40 years.  :)  The bags are well sewn.. not terribly thick, but cotton. title: waterproof cushion

title: Theraworx
text: Ok.  I waited to review this because I was nervous.  My husband is a big guy and travels A LOT.  On traveling days he has legs cramps at night.  Theraworx has literally STOPPED the cramps. I kinda feel like it's one of those rare things that actually works.  If you suffer from cramps, I would urge you to try it - invest  just once.  And review it!  This stuff is amazing. title: fitbit 3 face cover
