When you look at it from the side, it has a pressure rainbow - eh. Also, you wash your hands a lot or are near water, it holds water between the Fitbit and the cover... Eh.  I would suggest you hold onto your money or go directly to Fitbit and see if they have a quality cover.  To be honest, I took it off and threw it away.  Live and learn.

title: Jade stone heating pad
text: Technically this is a waist wrap... however... I have a specific spot on my neck and upper shoulders that I need the heat and I've tried numerous "neck" wraps.  This one is just right... it get the heat right where I need it.  The stones are toasty.  The cord has a remote that allows you to set the heat, the time and even a memory option to remember the setting.  Since I have to use this setting over and over, it's nice to have that.  I will say there is a little bit of a plasticy odor... but it seems to be dissipating.. There are 20 stones in the heating area - the stones are individually placed in nylon netted squares to keep them in place.  The stones are about 1" circles. About a 5x7 frame size heating area.  For me, the size is the first heating pad I've found that is the perfect size. You should also know that it is best used on fairly flat areas... its doesn't really conform to much curving.  I was worried the stones would be uncomfortable... but I do not even notice the bumps on the area I need to heat.  It says to allow 5-10 minutes to heat up - that seems to be about right on - somewhere in between that.. 7 or 8 minutes? It's a consistent heat... I am really liking it.  It also comes with a lovely fleece storage bag.  A nice, useful bonus.  You can't really wash it.  So that is something to note.  Keeping the dust off is useful with the storage bag.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: fitbit 3 stainless bracelet
text: Honestly, it was a real pain to fit the bracelet.  They send a tool - but it is tricky- get your extra strength readers and a good light out.  I had to remove 6 pieces.  Then you reattach the hook ends on each side.  After all that - the bracelet is oddly small - it looks really awkward with the size of the fitbit3 - of course, that is my personal opinion.  I purchased a different, but similar bracelet that was about twice as wide and WAY easier to fit (as most of the bracelet pieces are clips so you can remove any of them with ease) and the wideness balanced out the the size of the fitbit3.  This particular bracelet is not one I probably am going to use.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: star wars gift bag
text: I purchased this for my grandson's bday... so nice that it came with a matching card and tissue.  Easy button!

title: shimmer and shine
text: My 5 year grandson is a HUGE shimmer and shine fan... so these are perfect.  And it really helps to have the timer to make sure they brush an effective amount of time.  He is thrilled.  And so am I.

title: craft magnifier
text: I wanted to use this instead of reading glasses while working on my latest craft craze (diamond painting).. it didn't really work for that as I could never manage to get the magnifier out of my way as I worked!  Its large.. you look through it as it is hanging from your neck and resting on your chest.  So I personally found it too awkward.  However, it is a good magnifier.  It has a really useful light too.  So I use it  for magnifying other things.  The cord is quite thin and is adjustable, the glass has a good weight to it.  There is switch for the light.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: plastic champagne flutes
text: These are exactly as photo'd. You put the bases and flutes together... easy to do.  Just be sure the base is firmly attached to the flute before using.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: lysol disinfecting wipes
text: These are PERFECT for travel and that is what I purchase them for.  They easily fit in your purse or backpack. I use them on the airplane to wipe down all surfaces. It's known that airplane trays and knobs are more germ ridden than a toilet seat.  I use them when I get to the hotel to wipe remotes, phones, knobs, toilet seats, etc.  I won't be without these, period.  Helpful hint:  I put the ones I take with me on the plane in a  zip close plastic bag - because the pressurized atmosphere in the plane can cause the packets to leak a bit.  During this flu time of year, it's even more important to do what you can to stay as healthy as you can.  I have been purchasing and using these for years.  Love them.  Hope this info was helpful to you in some way!

title: pill organizer
text: I am not using these for pill organization... I am using them for mini snacks while I travel with my 2 grandsons.  I thought about mini tackle boxes, etc.. the reason I chose these is that each box opens separately.  So... it may be easier to handle, not to spill all the contents, just the one little section that is open. They are large for pills in my opinion.. but perfect for my use.  And small enough to put in my carry-on and bring out when needed.  Each section has a lid and they are pretty stiff - not too hard to open, but don't open really easily either.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Hope this info was helpful!

title: scar massager
text: Smells really great - like a spa treatment.  But it doesn't do much for reducing a scar.  Now.... it does sort of softened your skin... because it oily.  If you're looking to reduce the appearance of scar, hmmm.  Not sure this will work.  It did not for me - but perhaps we are all different.  I did really like the way it smelled...

title: glide flossers
text: These are impossible to find in local stores... And they work THE best.  I keep them everywhere.  And they go in my son-in-laws stocking every year because he and I agree - we can't live without them.  I do not like the other straight angle flossers, I can't work them as effectively as I can with these.  Hope they never stop making them!

title: Vertgo ease roll on
text: I have dual endolymphatic hydrops... which causes dizziness and some vertigo on occasion...  the medications they prescribe for such often is worse than the condition!  So I had high hopes.  I think I would rate somewhere between 3 and  4 stars... it smells very good -  like a spa treatment (in my opinion).  It comes in a roll on glass tube.  You apply it behind your ears on the back of your ear lobes... It rolls on thinly and evenly.  I then massage it in a bit.  It says that it can work in as little as 5 minutes.  I would say it did make me feel less nauseous and maybe a bit less dizzy within a few minutes... but not every time. .. In my opinion, the times it does work is once less dose of traditional medication I don't have to take.  All in all, if you suffer from some form of vertigo this may be worth a try.  I imagine everyone is different - and so each experience will be different too in degree of success.  I also suggest that you always share with your medical professionals that you are trying this - no matter if it is "natural" or not.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this info was helpful to you.

title: Genius Sleep aid
text: No effect of any measurable kind.  Disappointing.  Might work for some... but not for me, or my adult daughter.

title: natural peppermint oil pills
text: My gastro doc recommended I take some peppermint to help with my gut... IBS and Diverticulitis.  I had tried another national brand - green box and green pills... but I wanted to stay away from the artificial dye of those and searched for something produced in the USA.  I tried these.  No artificial anything - clear capsules.. produced in the USA.  I think they do help some... Just as a point... I would not try a supplement of any kind without checking with your doctor FIRST. Just because they are "natural" doesn't mean they don't contradict with other meds.  After that... I think these are good.  When you open the bottle - it smells like peppermint.  A good sign.  Nothing else.. no fennel or licorice or other additives.  Peppermint oil and peppermint leaf powder.  They are relatively small... easy to swallow.  I think they are worth a try if peppermint is something that works for you.  Made in the USA... no artificial anything..  I hope this review was helpful to you in some way!

title: readers
text: These are workable readers... although they are a bit loose on my head.. I have an "average" size head. .. so then you'd think maybe for a guy? But they are bit "froo froo" for a dude in my personal opinion.  Also, they did NOT come with covers/sleeves.  Eh.  As I said, they will work.. but could be better.

title: scotch no scratch pads
text: The set I got was the straight, lighter blue color.... I like the dark sway cut... but I will use these.  Cannot find them locally any more... so I purchased these for a bit more than I would have liked... and they took a fair amount of time to arrive.  Will try to source elsewhere.

title: 2.0 readers
text: purchased these to help me with my new craft obsession - diamond painting... These are a good solid quality.  The correction is full lens... I have an average size female head... they fit nicely and stay on as I am looking down at my project.  They also come with neoprene/like sleeves.  A nice bonus.  Always good to keep them sleeved when not in use.  They are solid black... nothing froo froo or fancy. Sleeves are also black.  Just function.  In my personal opinion, a fair quality and value.  4 glasses, 4 sleeves.

title: bead bags
text: Purchased these to store extra diamond painting drills that don't have the actual color stamp numbers.  They work perfectly as they are clear... easy to see and compare colors... they open and close as they should.  You could even put a white tab and with a pen, note which project they were leftovers from if you are that organized.  I believe these to be of decent quality and are a fair value.  3x4 inch size.  So a bit larger that an 2x2 - but I think these are easier to get in and out of - just a personal choice.

title: bright and beautiful
text: Purchased for my 80 year old mom and her purple walker and it is perfect. Both in terms of color and function.  It hangs about 12" and is more narrow, but offers plenty of space.  Lets face it... you don't want to "load" up extra weight to the walker period... but it offers plenty of space for useful stuff... water bottle... note pad... her cell phone... Has velcro type straps to attach to the forward bar of the walker.  It also offers an easy way to "ID" her walker - as there are quite a few in her adult living community.  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.

title: walker with seat
text: Purchased this for my 80 year old mom... she LOVES it.  She is just beginning to use a walker when she takes longer walks and feels like she might want to sit down on the longer walk.  She lives in an adult community and there are many walkers.. most are red or blue... this one is a lovely light purple - my mom's favorite color.  And it stands out in a "crowd" of walkers.  My brother was there when it arrived and put the parts that needed attaching in just a few minutes.  The adult community she lives in has an "expert" walker adjuster once a month so Mom is looking forward to having him adjust it to the perfect spot for her.  We did purchase a bag that attaches to the front of the walker for incidentals... a bottle of water... a notepad... her cell phone.  It also helps her identify that it is hers.  Mom is 5'6".. about 175 lbs.. The chair is well suited for her size and seems very sturdy, of an apparently good quality.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and as important as this piece of equipment it I will do that.

title: Blue Emu cream
text: I purchased this in Maui because I didn't see any other choices.  Since then I keep a tube of this stuff every where.  It's an AWESOME anti-itch cream.  In my personal opinion it was better than OTC cortisone or Afterbite (what I've used for years - the blue emu relief last MUCH longer than Afterbite) AND it smells better.  I have only used it on mosquito/bug bites.. but I think if might be good on many different "itches."  I am allergic to lidocaine - they doesn't contain anything I seem to be sensitive to.  It is difficult to find locally (coastal Oregon), so I'm glad to be able to get it on Amazon.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: Sweetleaf Lemon Lime water drops
text: Of all the stevia water flavor drops, these are my husband's favorite.  Very strong.  Only need a few drops - as opposed to other brands where you use quite a lot more.  He likes all the flavors too.  I would say if your water drop flavor fan, this brand is definitely worth a try!  Especially if you're trying to avoid artificial sweetners.  Stevia is the only "natural" choice beyond sugar.

title: ProCell batteries
text: I have always purchased batteries at the warehouse store... but honestly, I find these batteries to be every bit as good and a better price, delivered right to my door.  They seem to last as well if not a bit more than warehouse batteries I used to purchase. These are apparently "Duracell" so- maybe these last longer because they are "Procell?"  Not sure. I just know that they do appear to last as long if not a bit longer than the warehouse batteries.  Price is also a consideration for me.  And these are delivered to me (I can use Alexa to reorder so easily) and are cheaper than going to the warehouse and buying the name brand there - even on sale. I go through a pretty good number of batteries and I like it when they last as long as they can.  With 2 grandsons (4 and 7) and all the things they have that require batteries, it's an investment.  When I can use rechargables, I of course do.  But some things will not use the rechargables. I do recommend these.. they are worth ordering once and doing your own trial in my opinion.  I purchase more of the AA than any other size, but I have purchased AAA's, C's and D's as well with as much success. Hope this helps some.

title: Hard sided Insulin cooler
text: Husband travels a great deal and is a type 2 diabetic.  It's a challenge to keep pens cool and this hard case is has shown to be more useful than other soft sided ones we've tried.  Because it's hard sided, it is a bit big.. meaning it doesn't "squish" into spaces on carry on or other.  But again, the hard size seems to insulate a bit better.  It is a medium blue with black zipper, just as shown.  And measurements given are accurate.  I will update my review should new info seem useful. Hope this helps.

title: Sonicare 2 series plaque control
text: I have purchased about a dozen sonicares over the years... The last one was a fancy, charge in the glass - it lasted less than 2 years.  When I looked at how expensive it would be to replace the charger of that unit, it was more than purchasing this "lesser" sonic new.  I can say that they less fancy, no frills sonic toothbrushes have lasted the longest in my experience.  So I decided to go with this one rather than a new charger for the fancier one.  The toothbrush is basically white with coral accents.  The "footprint" of the base (which is the charging unit) is very small, which is nice if you have a small counter space. It uses the tooth brush inserts that pop on most of their models (NOT the screw in type) Honestly, I like it.  And you still get the great sonicare tooth/gum care.  But this model you don't get a lot of fanfare.  Perhaps that is best. I will update my review should new info seem useful.

title: bathroom scale
text: Husband needed a scale that he could travel with and he chose this one.  Travels great (Which I don't believe they would probably recommend) but it works and keeps him on track which is what we needed.  He travels 300 days a year... I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: Krud Kuttle window wash
text: Ran through the whole bottle after washing 3 smaller windows and I CAREFULLY used it.  Sheesh.  And it didn't work any better than the brand in the green bottle.  Green bottle brand lasts a LOT longer too.  I think they both cleaned about the same.

title: window wiper with long handle
text: I ordered a while ago and just got to try this ... so the cloth is microfiber like material ... but it is really thin.  I have two HUGE closet doors that are all mirror and purchased this for cleaning those.  I find that I can do half of one side and then wait for the cloth to dry and then do the other half... Ends up being an all day job for both sides. I don't use the squeegee portion as I am not soaking with cleaner.  I use a foam, non-ammonia based cleaner. The handle extends and there is a "spring" piece close to the head that makes a tad easier to get up under the edge at the top of my closet door. I wish it came with about 6 cloths so you could change them out and get the job done all at once.

title: shoe horn
text: works well, you don't have to bend all the way over. Works just like a shoe horn should.

title: pocket hand sanitizer
text: Little one ouncers... perfect for travel... and TSA "ok".  During this time of year, a MUST have.  The fragrance is "clean"... but I wouldn't call it "ocean"... I live on the ocean.. NO ONE would buy something that actually smelled like the ocean... hahaha...  my husband likes it as he says it doesn't smell too girly... just clean.  Hope that helps some.

title: cactus back scratcher
text: purchased for husbands xmas stocking.  He reports it's the best back scratcher ever - because it's rubbery, not metal or wood and it has 2 sides.. a "sharper" side for those really deep itches and nice, rounder side for the less urgent itch. Hahaha.  Thought it would be a great joke gift because he's kinda like a bear and uses door frames usually... wasn't a joke though and he actually uses it!

title: Fit Organic fruit and veggie wash
text: I've used this wash for years.  I like it, however, it is hard to find locally, so I end up purchasing from Amazon.  I am not a scientist so I can't really speak to the scientific effectiveness, but sure makes me feel better to use it, so I do.

title: Wool Dryer Balls 6 pak
text: Oh boy.  These are the BOMB compared to the blue plastic ones I've used for years.  Just from the "noise" aspect alone.  They do help loads to dry faster and I have NOT had any "lint" issues beyond the very first use - just empty your lint trap - as you would any way.  NO "sheepy" odor.  Just lovely, dry, static free clothing.  They are slightly larger than a tennis ball - maybe about softball size? They are ivory in color. You get six. I hope they last a nice long time too.  They feel like wool on the outside and are squishy. LOVE LOVE LOVE.  Having said all of this... and this being my first order... I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Hope this helps!

title: liquid spray silk plant cleaner
text: Hmm... I dusted off my silks first... then sprayed this stuff off on, carefully following directions.  I am not convinced it wasn't as effective to just dust the plants off and lightly rinse.

title: long squeegee window cleaner tool
text: Meh.  I was hoping for a streak free cleaning device... the cloth section is cotton or cotton like - not microfiber.  Thus, it streaks and leaves cotton fibers all along.  I have a 10 foot mirrored double closet door that needs dusting/cleaning every so often... this is not the tool for that use because of the cotton fibers.  I did like the long handle... I may try to use the squeegee portion on my car windshield.. however... it's a rather high price for that use.

title: Kleenex tissue tubes
text: So... I don't put these in my drink cup holders because I use the drink cup holders.  However, my car (2015 Optima) has a slot for a water bottle in the door... AND a fairly deep arm boot.  I put them in both of these places.  Keeps tissues handy and the hard tub is bit more sturdy than the square I was "forcing" into the boot area.  There are only like 40 tissues in each tube... but still I like them.  Also, I have tried the "reusable" tube version of this and I could NEVER get the tissues to "refill" properly, therefore they didn't dispense properly - came out all at once or not at all.  Turned out to be more of a frustration that useful - thus, I like these.

title: windex touch up cleaner
text: Can't find this locally, so ordering from Amazon is my backup.  I really like that you can put this on your toilet tank and it's there. Available. For when you need to wipe the seat or around the seat or just time to clean the bathroom. The dispenser is really what makes it.  Just press the pump a couple of times with a paper towel or even some toilet paper.  I like the "fresh" scent version best. I really like it and would say if you haven't used it, but like to have cleaning options that are quick and easy, you should try it.

title: long handle scrub brush
text: Ordered two of these, one of them was broken at the head, so it could not be screwed in.  Disappointing.  The other one twisted right in and looks as though it will work well... the broken one went into the trash.  It's a bummer when broken items get shipped.

title: 1.00 readers
text: I have ordered these numerous times to keep at all my "reading" spots... plus they walk off on their own once in awhile... my point is. I like these.  The lens are always clear seem optically correct.  Also the lens are a good size for my personal taste.  Not too big, not too small and NOT bifocal - which I hate.  The colors are at least similar to what is shown in the photo and less important to me - so I don't really track that in each order. And I really like that they come with handy cases.  Always a plus to keeping them scratch free for as long as possible. I just like having them everywhere I need them. Obviously I like them as I keep buying them!

title: Squatty potty
text:
UPDATE BELOW,...Adjustable height, 2 position, as noted on the ad. The photo represents well. It appears to be bamboo. It takes some getting used to, but I do like it. I am using on the higher position as I have a "comfort height" (taller) toilet. It fits back to the foot/base of the toilet when not in use which means you don't trip on it.. and don't have to use it every time. I don't have any scientific evidence it's worthwhile - after you get used to the strange position, it's functional. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: scalp massager
text: Ordered these on an impluse with telescoping back scratchers...  The "fingers" are pretty needle like... they have little nibs on the ends of each finger, but are still pretty sharp.  The fingers are pretty flimsy.  The handle is aluminum... and the whole thing is pretty lightweight.  I recommend using very, very slowly to avoid scratching your scalp.  :)

title: 55 gallon liners
text: Hey these are great.  For the price, good quality.  They fit my smaller commercial can with wheels (provided by the garbage service) The carrier just picks the whole bag out instead of picking out the individual bags which means anything "loose" inside the can usually stayed there.  So. I cleaned the can out really well... dried it and began using these. They lift the entire contents out now with these liners.  So far, so good.  They are thicker than I expected and I am pleased with my purchase.  Of course I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.

title: glad freezerware
text: These really are a better choice if you freeze stews and soups and such... they are thicker and slightly sturdier material than the regular storage containers.  I found they hold up quite nicely. I've actually been working toward "upgrading" all my food storage containers to these. I think they clean up better too... just my opinion. I would definitely say they are worth a try in terms of value and actual use.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: paper wrapped flexible straws
text: These are individually paper wrapped, flexible drinking straws.  I use them at family gatherings.  Because they are individually wrapped, I can easily store them with other party items and they stay clean.  I would buy these again!

title: ultra soft tissues
text: These are AWESOME for use in your car because they fit just about anywhere without issue.  I keep a few on hand just for use in my cars.  I will continue to buy these particularly because they are NOT the lotion version.

title: cardboard gift box
text: These are exactly as described... in measurement and photo - about 5x7. The inside is a white, sort of fleeced (?) thin board.  There are two little "arms" that are positioned at the top of one end that you can bend out to hang a necklace on and then bend back to hold the necklace in place.  It works perfectly for my use.  The outer box is VERY sturdy, but not super heavy.  Just a really nice presentation.  You can wrap them if you please, however, they are so nice, I really don't think they need it.  I got one of each of the colors shown in the photo.  They arrived quickly (i have prime) and in great condition.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: gamma ray reading glasses
text: I have ordered these a few times and continue to be happy with them.  They last a reasonable amount of time before I replacement them - usually due to scratches that occur with normal use. I don't use the sunglasses set often, but it can be handy when sitting outside, on the beach or at the pool.  They are fairly lightweight... I use the lowest strength - 1.00.  I had lasik surgery... and as a result my regular sight is 20/20 and my reading strength dropped dramatically... I was usually the 2.00 before.  In any case, I am sensitive to glasses that feel uncomfortable or heavy on my nose and these are very comfortable.  In my opinion these glasses are definitely unisex... and are not flowery, bright or fancy in any way - all are slightly different color - but simple.  They are truly what I would call "functional" in every way.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: Macks water ear plugs
text: I've waited to write a review on these until I had used them consistently for a while... Meh.  The stems are very flimsy making them difficult to control and insert to properly block water. Sometimes they make a seal, some times not.  They have suggestions on how make them work better (such as, using your opposite arm, reach over your head and pull your ear up while inserting) - looks like and feels like a yoga move - which would be fine if it worked.  It may be that my ears are just not the right shape for these?  In any case, three stars for sometimes working. If you are like me and MUST keep water out of your ears, these are probably not the best. Wish I could suggest some that do work... will keep hunting and update my review if new info would seem useful.

title: Hearos earplugs
text: Bought these to carry around in my purse as occasionally noise is an issue for me.  The case is a long, oval shape.  The earplugs are the squishy kind and work for the purpose.  Wish the case was a bit smaller.  It's kind of an awkward shape and size.  Other than that... I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: Depend Night Defense
text: I purchased these after experiencing some "challenges" during my first colonscopy...  I felt these could be useful and they were!  I only used 2 of them.  But I will have to have this procedure again in 5 years and I will use these then.  I am glad I don't have to use them daily but if I did, these would be a possibility.  They are thicker... probably because they are "night defense."  They were comfortable and didn't feel "paper."  I did buy one size up because I wanted to be able to take them off quickly and that worked perfectly for my use.

title: clorox disinfecting wipes
text: PERFECT for traveling.... I use on the plane to wipe down my personal seat area, seat belt clasp, buttons and food trays... then at the hotel to wipe down remotes, door handles, bathroom surfaces - really any surfaces in my room.  I just wish they were available locally!  I like the "yellow" pack citrus fragrance over the green, but I take what I can get!  One tip... I put them in a ziplock bag when flying... in a pressurized cabin, they can "leak" the fluid out of the opened package...  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

title: dymatize clear whey drink
text: So.... this is so awful in smell and flavor. I purchased to use before a procedure that required "clear liquids." I was not able to drink these AT all... and to be fair, ANY of the other brands of "clear" protein drinks I purchased to try. For me, it was about the smell of the whey....it was... overwhelming and nauseating. It was supposed to be "fruit punch" flavored and I could not imagine HOW that even a possibility. I am posting this review based on my personal experience, you experience may differ and disagree with mine. I respect that and hope you can too.

title: lift protein orange drink
text: If you don't mind a REALLY strong smell of whey and the strong taste of whey, you might like this. I could not find ANY "orange" flavor at all!  I could not drink them. I donated to local elder care home.

title: vitamin d gummies
text: My doctor prescribed 5000 units a day and I wanted to like it... so I tried these.  Yum... but you have to like gummies!  They don't taste like vitamins at all.. however, after blood tests, they did work - my vitamin d levels were up - making my doctor happy.  I would happily recommend these.

title: Schiff Digestive Advantage
text: I love love love these.  A treat AND a probiotic.  They are supposed to "last longer" to get further down into your gut... honestly I've used about a dozen or more other probiotic brands... most leave me feeling gassy and uncomfortable.  These do not!  I look forward to chewing them!  I am a huge fan.  As far as I can tell (and my gastro) they seem to work!  (also... watch for sales at costco and grab them cheaper). I am always open to questions or comments.

title: flower cane
text: Purchased for a neighbor who needed a bit of help with balance while walking after a stroke.  It's nice that it stands on it's own while she reaches for something at the store.  It is also very pretty.  It adjusts to just about any persons height.  She is about 5'4".  I will update with any new info if would seem useful.

title: REALLY soft toothbrushes
text: These are the softest toothbrushes I have ever purchased.  I purchased them to try with a charcoal tooth polishing product.  I gave up that stuff as a tooth polish, but will use these toothbrushes to help polish/clean my silver and such.

title: charcoal teeth treament
text:
After reading other reviews and even other charcoal powders, I purchased this for the whitener aspect. After using per directions, I have noted absolutely no change in the shade of my teeth. My front four teeth are porcelain overlays, the rest are entirely natural. There are a couple of things to note...

text:
After more than 20 years of contact wear and at 55 years old, I opted for lasik eye surgery. While it has been positively life changing, the dry eyes I was really beginning to have with age and length of contact use, has not subsided. I am now 6 months past the surgery so I am able to try eye drops that contain preservatives - initially after surgery my surgeon said to use only drops without preservatives. The dryness I have now a similar feeling to when you've worn your contacts just a bit too long or they need cleaning or a new pair. But this is something that is noted may occur with this surgery. A small exchange for the ability to wake up each day and see clearly without glasses or contacts. I REALLY loved "Aquify" when I was wearing contacts but they were discontinued several years ago. I have been struggling to find a suitable replacement since. I purchased these this week and began using them in the morning and at night. I am really hoping to find something that is long lasting and comfortable.
First, I received 2 larger bottles. Some eye drops are in such small bottles. These bottles are EACH 1.8 ounces. They are a bit expensive, but comfort is a premium to me (just my opinion). These are a nice viscosity - not super thin (blinks right out) and definitely not a "gel" that blur your vision for many minutes. They stay in... and within a few blinks your vision is clear. I had no burning, no irritation of any kind. In fact it feels soothing and maybe a bit cooler. I am comfortable all day, using the drops once in the morning and then at night. My only concern is that the drops I received expire 10/17. With such large bottles, I hope I can get them used by then.

title: blue magic foam carpet stain remover
text:
First, let me say that I DID NOT receive this product for free or discounted, nor was I solicited in ANY way to review this product. You can see my purchase is VERIFIED. Further, my purchase was 100% INDEPENDENT and so are my opinions. That out of the way, I would say that this is one of those rare products I wish I could give a higher rating than 5 stars for!
I have included a few pictures.... wish I would have taken even more before and afters because it worked that well. My carpet is very high end "sculpted berber" in case that helps you compare what you have. It is a sort of darker tan with flecks of turquoise color - about 10 years old. (yes, it's ready for replacement) I have pretty much tried about every carpet cleaner out there trying to remove old stains. I suspect the biggest issues I had were old "puppy potty training" stains, but who can know for sure this long ago... Anyway... please see my pictures to see what I did. I purchased the pump spray and the aerosol "foam" spray Blue Magic... Pump version vs foam.... For a second you can see the exactly where the foam sprayed... maybe there is an advantage in knowing were the bulk of the product sprayed for a brief second... however, I didn't see any real difference in stain lifting ability. Also, I did purchase a soft, hand held scrub brush to do a light scrub before blotting the product off. Once I saw how quickly and efficiently it remove those gray, plate size spots (about 6 were in the area shown in "after" shot - wish I would have taken a before shot of the whole area), I got braver and tried on a really dark brown drip spot (who knows what it was - I suspect my husband) - I had to do a couple of treatments and use the scrub brush, but it lifted even that stain! Oh... also on the brush, I had purchased the Resolve system (foam cleaner with attached to a long handled scrub brush - so you can stand while scrubbing) and I have taken to using that and then patting with a paper towel and my feet... It's hard for me to get down on my hands and knees. This has worked so well my neighbor borrowed to try on a stain she's had for years. She reports with a couple of treatments it lifted the old mystery stain right up.
It does have a slight odor... but not a bad one... clean smelling in my opinion. But I would not report that it has a freshening ability. I was worried it smell chemically and am I happy to report that it does not.
It says "removes stains in one step - no vacuuming required." It's actually a couple of steps in my estimation... Apply the product... scrub...(or not - your choice)...wait 30 seconds (15 seconds on a fresh stain).... and then blot, firmly, several times. You can decide if that is "one" or more steps.
It also warns that you should test your carpet before using.... I did not.... only because we are going to replace it and it was my thought it can't be worse than it already is... But I do recommend following their directions.
As with all chemicals it says to keep out of reach of children.

No matter what the cause of your nausea is, I highly recommend you try this. Just one. And I hope it will work for you with as much success as it has been for me. I am convinced it works.

title: I used to be more of a fan
text:
I purchased from the seller's website. No "auto order." I have not received ads and/or any other types of annoying media.
I have been suffering through nearly 2 years of tests, trying to figure out why I'm having abdominal pain, distention, debiltating nausea. Had my gall bladder removed, no difference. So far tests have not discovered the cause for any of the suffering. Doctors have decided it's IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome) - which is what they classify anything they can't figure out. Not so comforting. I had been taking a probiotic (just whatever was on sale) for years. Because of all the issues I've been having within the last 2 years, I just stopped taking EVERYTHING I was taking, including vitamins, for about 4 months. I just began taking these about 2 weeks ago and only these to start with. Will try to add vitamins next month. Honestly, I can say I feel less bloating (proven by measurements)... I do, as others have reported, feel much less inclined to eat sweets (odd, I know - could be the power of suggestion I suppose) and overall just feeling... better.... digestively more normal. Less urgent runs to the bathroom... less random constipation.... Subjective, I know. But if you were in my shoes you would consider this a major victory.
I do think I will keep taking these. They are expensive, but if they work, I'm on board and will try a few more months worth.To "test" I may try something else in a few months to see if this brand is the difference, or just any probiotic will work. I will update later if I think it would be helpful.
The one "negative" thing I could say is that I am not fond of the bad breath that is result of most probiotics... seems a bit more with these than others I've tried. But no one other than me has reported being offended by my breath. :) So I would take that as just a personal note.
If you're considering these, and have some similar issues, I would say give them a try. I know others have reported being afraid of the keybiotics website and being stuck with "auto robo order" but I ordered mine without any of that. And they are a bit cheaper going through their site than on Amazon. Although peace of mind is priceless so do as you need to for yourself.
UPDATE 7/30/2014.... I have finished one month's worth of these... the "desiring less sugar" effect is really not evident. However, I do think I feel better overall. My gastro issues are individual to me and flucuate, so it's hard to certain, but I think it has made a positive difference, reducing the numbers of days I feel bloated and reducing the number of "urgency" issues. Overall, while I think any higher number probiotic will probably work, I have another 2 months supply of these and will continue using them.
UPDATE SEPTEMBER 2014.... I just placed an order for another batch. You should know that they have "changed" the formulation along with a few other things... they now come in brown glass bottles and with a dehumdifier packet. I called the company... the old bottle says "500mg" per one capsule, the new one "124mg" per cap. When asked about the difference I was told that they removed the "vegetable cellulose and sugars, however the bacteria remains the same." Just comparing the old capsules with the new, the old are a tan color and have a slight odor... I don't find unpleasant. The new ones are a bright ivory color and there is really no odor. I was also told the new way of mixing the formula prevented the capsules from turning brown. Hmmmmm.. I hope I am not the sucker born this moment and the capsules are just a flem-flam. I also told the representative it was very disappointing that the changes were not explained clearly and revealed on the website so that you could make a buying decision with the new information. Kinda shady. I am feeling less supportive at this moment and dropping one star off my review. I will try the new ones and report back if there are any issues.
UPDATE JANUARY 16 2015... I have used many months of these including the "new" version...Honestly, I think these are no better than most other probiotics and I recommend trying as many as you can and sticking with what works and what fits in your budget. These are definitely on the high end of cost and you must order via mail - meaning they are not in stores (or that I am aware of) I think I will go back to Phillips colon health as in MY opinion, they work best for me and are more reasonably priced.
